notes.notes:
Hi folks,

The two latest builds again contain mostly modding additions & resources for modders, but also some quite important bugfixes. So it's recommended that you update your game to version 1.031 regardless the branch you are in. (If you haven't already)

Normally I would skip the news post (Patch Notes section in the discussion board always contains the latest patch notes), but the rule for 'Hideouts' has also changed so I thought to give you the heads up. 

You can now have only one Hideout in play (regardless of the Hideout's name.) 

Existing save games will still work, but if you have any Hideout in play you will end up with two instances of the same Hideout. i.e a 'Vampire Lair' and a 'Hideout' that is a Vampire Lair. 

So if you have any Hideouts in your current save don't Summon any new Hideout permanents, till the ones in play are unsummoned/destroyed. ;)

Last but not least, if you are in the Development branch you'll be happy to know that the DLC preview now contains 158 new Cards to experiment with.

Have a great week, and let me know if you encounter any issues!

 Harmless Synergies Mod 

As you well know (or may have come to realize), negative synergies in cards that target you will harm your character. And getting around that - i.e have your Echo actions target enemies, unequip/not use harmful equipment when advancing in a new node, choose what you'll equip tactically etc. (see the many discussions on the topic in the forum for more tactics) -  is part of the trade-off to the powerful combos you can pull off using Echo chains & Synergy. With power comes responsibility. 

Still many new players may find overcoming this trade-off confusing at first, overwhelming or inconvenient. There are game mode options that get around that & I also put a mod in the Workshop that automatically uses them/activates in all Vanilla game modes a protection from such harmful synergies, and in the case of higher difficulty game modes make all equipment 'Active' so you can target/use it whenever you want, for those who don't know yet how to customize their game experience with the Custom Game Mode editor.

You can find the mod here:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1923178773

It doesn't do anything you can't already do in the Custom Game Mode editor. But if you just want a mostly vanilla experience, without worrying about accidentally harming yourself while learning the ropes, this mod should do the trick ;)

 Patch Notes - v1.030-31 

 Card Changes 

 'Backpack' card now has limited uses and no longer casted automatically
 There can be only one 'Hideout' permanent in play (regardless of the Card Name) i.e a 'Vampire Lair' played after the 'Old Well' will replace it as your 'Hideout'. This change will take effect on new games, so it's recommended to start a new game. Older save-files will work normally but you may end up having both a 'Vampire Lair' & a 'Hideout' that is a 'Vampire Lair'. (If you preferred the old Hideout system just create an override mod that removes the 'UniqueType:1' from their definitions)


 Bugfixes 

 AP discounting perks & synergies could (in some casting methods) make the 0 AP-cost Actions go negative & restore player's AP by that amount
 Death Knight was missing the Apprentice Summoner perk at level 4. (If you use any mods modifying the vanilla Death Knight you may want to add "Apprentice Summoner:4" in their perk trees as well.)
 Expert Electromancer perk wasn't properly giving the Air Affinity bonus
 In Sling Bay: Added a fisherman that can take player back to Seagull's Rest so they won't get stuck there after completing all the challenges
 Perk Points reward in Challenges wasn't properly awarded upon the Challenge completion


 Misc Additions 
 
 Improved the wording of some Card Rules, to make clearer what they do
 Negative buffs like inflicting Bleeding on you, will now display in red color and mention clearer that this is a negative effect targeting you.
 Added the missing Nephilim Hideout.


 Modding Additions 

 Added support for OnCasterStatus[Affinity]--:x type of checks. Contingency will trigger if the Casters Amplified Affinity is less than x. i.e OnCasterStatusBludgeoning--:3, will trigger if the player Bludgeoning Damage (amplify bonus) is less/equal to 3.
 Daybreak:1 & Nightfall:1 can be used as Action effects to set the World Clock to Sunrise (6am) or Midnight.
 New Action Keyword: UniqueType:1, (along with Unique:1), can make a Summon Type (SummonRace:[Type]), Unique. 
 ie using Unique:1, UniqueType:1, SummonRace:Hideout will name the Unique Summon as 'Hideout' instead of [Cardname]. The next 'Hideout' played (if also uses UniqueType:1) will replace the previous Summon.
 New Perk Keyword: Unique:[Unique Category], in a Perk as benefit, will lock/remove all perks from the player that also are of this Unique Category
 i.e if there are 3 Perks with Unique:Specialization & the player picks one of them the other two will get locked/removed from their perk list
 [Unique Category] can be anything that makes sense in the modder i.e Faction, Specialization, Blood Type, Hair Color, Alien Abduction Result
 The player won't see this category label, modder can include some sort of warning in the description any way they prefer: i.e 'Blood Type (You can have only one 'Blood Type' Perk). You gain blah blah...'

notes.title: Game Mode Changes & Additions
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg

Hi folks!

This build changes most of the game modes to create a more progressive difficulty curve across the vanilla modes, and incrementally introduce the various mechanics that might be different from similar games.

My hope is that each of the new game modes will offer you new ways to experience the game and to discover some of the vast possibilities to customize it. Then go and create your own game modes and custom difficulties, because you can. ;)

You can read some of the new possibilities in the patch notes below, check what the Game Mode editor can do, and of course when you are ready to take the next step: the Modding Guide in the Community Guides section.

Coming week I'll be taking a short break from development, to just play and enjoy the game and maybe make some more Gameplay videos. 

 So if you haven't already make sure to join our Discord server to share your feedback, ideas and to discuss balance. ;)

Let me know if you encounter any issues and of course have fun!

 EA Build 0251  

 Misc Gameplay & Game Mode Related Changes 


 Edited several events to improve their functionality and add additional choices & options
  Event nodes now have higher chances to trigger an event instead of a looting opportunity
  Added separated (additional) nodes with card picking (drafting) opportunities
  In Adventure Mode's Hourglass: Added a Preparation Phase (Spend 5 AP: Choose 1 out 4 Actions & Draw it.), Replaced the 'Exploration Action', New Exploration option costs 5 AP & has 45% chance to trigger encounter, 15% chance to yield a Ration, 15% chance to Choose an Action among 2 and will always yield 3 xp.
 Deactivated the Game Modes: Endless, Puppeteer (Savefiles using them should still work and you can still add them as mods if you miss them.)
 Edited/Changed the following Game Modes:
 
 Adventure (Set difficulty to Normal)
 Draft (Set difficulty to Normal). Is now a Class/Race Draft. (The old vanilla Changeling/Jack of all Trades Draft Game Mode is renamed to 'Changeling' and is still available in the Game Modes folder but deactivated.)
 Expert Set Difficulty to Ironman++, Start with Empty Deck & all unlocked Skills available to add to your Deck
 Added 3 Puppeteer Game Modes: Mentalist (Normal+), Seer (Ironman+) & Demigod (Ironman++)
 Puppeteer now leaves the original nodes revealed. You can can use 'Continue' to proceed to the original node instead of altering it.
 All Vanilla game modes will display their simplified descriptions. (You can look up their detailed rules in the codex.)
 Increased all completion rewards to feel more rewarding



 Bugfixes 

 In Adventure mode: any town nodes encountered mid-stage are converted to the 'A Small Settlement' event.
 In Adventure mode: only 1 of the possible rewards was shown at end of the stage


 Modding Related Additions  

 Events Additions 

 Events can now support up to 15 different choices
 New 'Reward' property: RemoveChoice:AndRepeat, will remove the choice and then re-render it after re-evaluate its requirements. (Use this if a choice is repeatable, but it has requirements.)


 New Game Mode Properties 


 "ActivateHourglass": true, will activate the Adventure mode Hourglass Button=>'Explore' Event in your current Game Mode
 Added Hourglass option in the Game Mode Editor under Special Handlers
 "BlankSlate":true, will remove all Cards, Class Skills & Perks from the character
 Added Draft + BlankSlate option in the Game Mode Editor under Draw Phase
 "ClearStartingDeck":true, will just empty the Starting Deck, to customize it faster (Manual Only)
 "AdjustSkillLevelReqsBy":x, will increase or reduce the Skill Level Requirements by x (Manual Only)


 EA Build 0251.1 - Hotfix 

 Some of the help (?) buttons weren't working after build 0250
 Some Summon cards were missing Racial type
 Summoning from a copy was causing in some cases Allies to lose their Racial type
 Targeting an Ally missing Racial Type with a TargetArchetype effect would cause an exception error
 In some cases 'Let's Train!' wouldn't work properly on Hunter's Wolf Companion and he wasn't automatically resummoned.
 Perks modifying ExpendBuff[Buff] will now work properly. Syntax is: ModifyEffectExpendBuff[Buff]:x i.e. ModifyEffectExpendBuffGrace:-1 (whenever you are Expending Grace you spend 1 less.)

You can of course modify them like they were before or change the difficulty settings as you please if you feel this makes things way too easy. Because it does. 

If you still find Casual & Normal difficult I want to also remind you that you are more than your class: 1/3 of your card pool are racial cards, do take advantage of what they can provide and of course feel free to create easier game modes in the Custom Mode Editor.

Additionally for the classes and races who feel more attuned unclad (Nymph, Witch & Spelldancer) their relevant archetypes now all rely in 'Grace' and will play better together.

notes.title: Maintenance Update + Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi folks, 

This is actually a minor update, but the build is unnaturally large as is a maintenance update and upgrades the Unity Engine to the latest version.

So first run might be a bit slower than usual. Second should speed up things a lot, and game should overall perform better than before.

If you have any issues let me know either in the forum or in Discord: https://discord.gg/CmnnneV

 EA Build 0246.1 - Hotfix & Addon 

 Maintenance Update 

 Updated Unity Engine to latest stable version (v2019.2.1f1). This will increase the update size by a lot, as all binaries and libraries got rebuild from scratch, so unfortunately there is no way around it. But the good news is that the updated Unity engine includes many improvements, performance optimizations & stability fixes and should overall perform faster after the second run.


 Bugfixes 

 When previewing a Racial or Class set in the Character Creation screen cards from Shared Disciplines and Additional Actions will also display there (if any). Such cards will now indicate that they are part of a different Discipline as well (as you need mastery in that discipline to unlock).
 Passive Equipment Cards (Armors & Accessories) weren't gaining XP. (They will now gain +1 XP each turn they trigger.)
 Invoke & ChooseOneRandom Card effects will no longer create Consumables or cards that have been explicitly excluded from loot (with ExcludeFromRandomLoot:1). Not a bug really, as Consumables also count as Action Cards, but it didn't make sense in most cases flavor-wise. Changed Human Card: Backpack as it no longer had flavor and as a consequence Sturdy Rope & Torch cards as well.


 Misc Changes 

 Enemy Gallery could take a long time to load in large Enemy Databases or in older rigs. Instead of displaying all Enemies right away, Gallery will load quickly blank & you can now just choose a Category which will be quite fast in most cases (or 'All' to view all Enemies like before.)


 Archetype Modding Additions 

 Archetypes Race & Classes can now count as additional races or classes for the purposes of targeting, immunities, weaknesses etc using "CountsAs":"Race/Class/Faction" (comma list) 
 i.e a Lich race could "CountsAs":"Undead, Mystic", will treat the Lich as both Undead and Mystic
 i.e a Dhampir could "CountsAs":"Human, Vampire", will treat Dhampir as both human and vampire etc.
 This will make the Race or Class a valid Target for TargetArchetype effects or relevant Auras like Desecrate or Consecrate. i.e a Succubus race could "CountsAs":"Demon" and properly receive Desecrate heal & Consecrate damage. Won't grant any additional cards or disciplines, and the additional templates doesn't have to be playable. In enemies for example CountAs will also affect their resistances to certain effects. i.e a custom Oakfolk enemy race could also "CountsAs":"Plant" and inherit all Plant immunities
 Vampires & Death Knight Archetypes updated to use this new property, nothing much changed though as they were already counting as Undead
 Runecaster Archetype updated to use this new property and now also counts as a Dwarf


 Build 0246.2 - Hotfix & Addon 

 'Training' Wolf Companion would cause him to lose his artwork (Edited Card: Wolf Companion)
 Invoke and ChooseOneRandom couldn't create Herbs as they are Singleton & Singleton cards were excluded from the card pool. Singleton cards that are also Spell Component cards were added back into the pool.
 Fixed some issues in the Wildshape Loop both for Animist & Lycanthrope. 
 Replaced 'Claim Soul' from Demon's Skill list with 'Infernal Contract' (Claim Soul is supposed to be crafted only when certain circumstances are met)
 Nerfed Wildshape loops for both Animist & Lycanthrope
 Edited Cards: Wildshape, Hybrid Form, Claw Attack, Claw Strike & Feral Strike. 
 Hybrid Form each turn will now create a Feral Strike, which upon draw will create an additional (Reaction) Claw Strike
 Wildshape (Animist Card) each turn will now create a Claw Attack, which upon draw creates a copy of itself
 Edited Cards: Hunter's Brew (Penalty way too harsh)


 Modding Additions & Notes for Modders 

 Enlightenment effect can now target an Ally. If does the Ally will gain the XP instead. (You can enforce targeting an Ally if necessary using TargetTypeAlly:1)
 Localization file changes:
 "CodexEnlightenment":"Enlightenment x: A valid Target (You or Ally) Gains x XP.",

notes.title: Huge Content Update! (Development Branch)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg

Hi folks!

Build 0240 is now in the Development Branch and it's huge! How huge? Let's just say it has over 320+ new cards, a gazillion new Action effects & mechanics and lots of changes and improvements.

So take things slowly as almost nothing is as you knew it ;)

These are the highlights:

 The minimum Deck size is now 18 cards. Except for Draft (Still 12 Cards in Draft).
 All Classes now have 80 Cards, that they are no longer shared and new Assignment of Starting Decks & Skills.
 Runecaster became a Dwarven caste that you can pick as a Race instead of a class.
 I removed the gender restrictions from races & classes (added though a soft recommendation)


I'll leave this build in the Development Branch (and my keyboard in the attic) for 8 Days and fetch my notepad to do some world building. 

After that still need to add/edit new Perks in all races and classes, and continue with the rest items I mention in the Roadmap, so keep that in mind as you test the new Card Sets: That Perks will slightly change to accomodate new Cards, and reduce the: 'you get +2 Astral meh feeling.'

I also don't expect the sets to be totally balanced, so it would be nice if all of you switch to the Development Branch and spend some quality time with this build. :) Trust it's more stable than the one in main branch, and you can always revert if something goes wrong and you get tons of new content! What's not to like?

On the other hand, if none gives me feedback is what you'll end up getting :P

So Dev branch! Win win situation. ;)

Looking forward to hear your thoughts on the new Card/Skill Sets and how its combination you tried performs!

 After Updating to 0240 

I recommend to disable any localization mods, and any mods that modify vanilla classes & races then start a new game.

 EA Build 0240 - Development Branch 

 Completed Card Sets 

 Each Class set now has 80 Cards.
 Runecaster is now a Race (A Dwarf Caste to be more precise) instead of Class, and has 40 Cards
 Modified the .json files of all Classes & Races
 Adjusted the Proficiences & Resistance of all Races & Classes
 Adjusted the Initial Skills & Starting Decks of all Races & Classes
 Races & Classes can now contain a Description field.
 
 ie. "RaceDescription":"Race description goes here\nthis is a new line."
 ie. "ClassDescription":"Class description goes here\nthis is a new line."

 Added flavor/lore descriptions in all classes and races
 Removed Gender Restrictions. (They are now just recommendations.)
 Players start with 18 Cards + 1 Equipment
 Min Deck is now 18 Cards for all modes except Draft. (Min size in Draft is still 12)


 Bugfixes 

 When Smart Casting an Action to First Enemy or Ally, and they are already marked for destruction, Action will attempt to Target the next available Enemy or Ally, till they find one or evaluate the first 5.
 There was a typo in the preview text of Allies with the Legacy Defensive Stance, messing up the preview text formatting
 Death Knight counts as an Undead in addition to their Race
 Discard effect was looking for Actions in the Battlefield not in the Hand i.e could Discard cards in the Choose One Dialog instead from Hand
 Fixed a couple formatting errors in the Combat Log caused by Localization
 Caught an exception when using chaotic actions and the target has died
 Improved Invoke/Choose One Random algorithm


 Notes for Modders 

 Localization Additions & Changes 

 Localization file updated for builds 0240+. You can find the new entries below the build marker:
 ">>>>Patch 0240": "Entries below were added in Build 0240. Don't forget to include them in any older Localization files!",
 Added the key association for looking up Statuses & Keywords in the Codex
 The following lines in English.json were changed:

 "CodexFreeze":"Frozen/Frostbite x: Target gains x Frozen counters & can't Act for as long as they have these counters. Additionally loses 1 HP per counter. Non-Immune Enemies have a 25% chance to resist this effect.\n\nWhen damaging an Immobilized, Frozen or Bewitched Target, 1 counter breaks for every 3 damage dealt (above 3). ie 1 counter if dealt 3-5 damage, 2 counters if dealt at 6-8 damage etc. If the card both deals damage and inflicts the status the damage required to remove a counter increases by +3.\n\nFor Players this Status is converted to 'Frostbite'. Instead of 'Unable to Act' Player loses 3 AP per Frostbite Status.",
 "CodexRetribution":"Retribution x:  Distribute up to x Intense Damage to each Enemy attacking you this Turn.\n\nRetribution Damage is a kind of damage deposit. If it is not completely used up by an opponent, the remaining surplus is passed on to the next opponent and so on. When all opponents act, you lose all remaining Retribution.",



 The following DoTs will now affect the Player similar to how they affect the enemies: 

 Bleeding x: Player will lose 1 HP / Bleeding Status. 
 Burning x: Player will lose 5 HP / Burning Status.
 Envenomed x: Player will lose 3 HP / Envenomed Status.
 Frostbite x: Frozen Status will affect the Player as Frostbite. Won't get immobilized but will lose 1 HP & 3 AP / Frostbite Status
 These effects will be set with Bleed, Burn, Venom & Freeze if the Actions that have them target the Player
 They can also be set with CustomBuff[Buff] i.e CustomBuffFrostbite:2, CustomBuffBleeding (when we want to inflict them to Player, prevent the optimal target changing to Enemy & prevent affecting the Enemy)


 New Action Effects 

  ControlArchetype[Archetype/Faction]:x, If Target is (of) [Archetype] & has Power less/equal than x, they become an Ally for [Card Level] Turns. Once the effect ends they are removed from Combat. 
  TargetArchetype[Archetype/Faction]:1, Unless the Target belongs in the required Archetype or Faction, Action will Fail.
  TargetArchetype can also be non-Undead
  TargetType[Self,Ally,Enemy]:1, Unless the Target is of the required Type, Action will Fail. (Unlike Optimal Target this is a hard requirement for the Action to Work.)
  CustomBuff[Buff]:x, Player gets +/-x "Buff". This "Buff" doesn't have any effect on each own, however it can be used in conjuction with contingency effects.

  i.e CustomBuffVengeance:3, Player gets Vengeance 2. Vengeance doesn't exist as a Buff. The modder made it up.
  OnCasterStatusVengeance:4, ContingencyEffectWrath:8, if the Player has Vengeance 4 deal 8 Wrath Damage etc.
  i.e CustomBuffClarity:2, Player gets Clarity 2.
  OnCasterStatusClarity:2, ContingencyEffectSense Thoughts#:1, if the Player has Clarity 2, craft the Card Sense Thoughts etc.
  Custom Buffs will Debuff along with Defend,Retribution etc. during the Debuff phase
  You can use ie. CustomBuffDefend:x, to adjust the player's Defend (or any other existing Buff). 
  CustomBuff has the highest trigger priority after Empower, so it will trigger before the Contigency effect resolves

  DebuffAll[Buff]:1, Player loses all their points of Buff. 

  i.e DebuffAllDefend:1, Player loses all their Defend.

  ExpendBuff[Buff]:x, Player loses x points of Buff. If they can't Action fails.

 i.e ExpendBuffVigilance:2, Unless the player can pay 2 Vigilance Action fails. (Vigilance 2 is a CustomBuffVigilance:2)
 if the Action triggers multiple times ie. due to Multicast or Fury, Expend Cost is paid only once.

 Afterimage[Cardname]:x, After this Action (successfully) resolves, Create and Play x [Cardname]. You don't pay its AP cost, but still pay any Expend costs normally. [Cardname] Targets automatically You, Your first Ally or Your first Enemy (depending who is the Optimal Target). A card can have only one Afterimage effect.
 BloodTribute[Cardname]:x, If after this Action (successfully) resolves its target dies, Create and Play x [Cardname]. You don't pay its AP cost, but still pay any Expend costs normally. [Cardname] Targets automatically You, Your first Ally or Your first Enemy (depending who is the Optimal Target).
 Flavor:[Text], will add a flavor text at the end of the card description
 OverrideDesc:[Text], will override the card text with a fixed text (no numerical values are calculated). Flavor will append to that text if it exists.

 Both Flavor & OverrideDesc can't have the , character in their text. If you need one use the ; character. It will be replaced with a comma:
 i.e [card effect], OverrideDesc:Deal 5 + Card Level Intense Damage; if the Target is Witch; Warlock; or Necromancer., [next card effect]

 Blood Offering:x, Lose x HP & Gain x/2 Blood Surge. Blood Surge can be used by Blood Mages to trigger various additional effects in their Actions. Any Unused points Debuff at End of Turn.

 (This effect could have been recreated by using negative Healing and a CustomBuff, but whereas Card Upgrades reduce the HP cost they increase both Blood Offering cost & gain and I wanted to be able to use it as a Synergy.)

 Spell Component:1, This card won't trigger any Active Synergies, but instead Modify or Expand them with additional effects.

 i.e You play a card with Synergy Damage & Synergy Defend. If the next card is not a Spell Component those effects will be added to the next card you play and trigger as normal. If it is a spell component they'll be ignored, and any synergies in the Spell component will be added in the Active Synergies.



 Build 240.1 - Hotfix 

 Several Blood Mage cards had Blood Tribute 'Funnel Blood', where the correct card name is 'Blood Funnel'
 Smart Cast could cause an exception if the Smart-casted Card had a mistyped or incorrect name
 'Combat Schooling' targets & Unsummons a Nomad before choosing either Upgrade.

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0235 (Development Branch)
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

This build almost finalizes the Localization support, and I think that over 95% of the text resources in Erannorth Reborn can now be translated in other languages. It might be obvious, but I have to mention it: you can also have localization Mods that changes the English translation of the game to American English, British English, grammatically-correct English (because as you know I am not a native speaker) etc. Or to otherwise change things as you see fit.

The (randomly :P) estimated 5% includes a few things I might missed by accident, the Custom Game Mode Editor & the Adventure UI. I'll be adding the text resources for the Custom Game Mode Editor & the Adventure UI at a later time. The Adventure UI is pretty much a work in progress and may end up changing a lot, and the Custom Game Mode Editor may end up as part of a separate toolkit (still undecided on that).

If you are planning to start working on translating the core localization file (English.json) you can safely do that. If you are already working on a translation mod, 'Notes to Translator Modders', section below contains important information on how to update your existing files to this build (and any future builds that will add things in the localization file) easily.

I didn't have any issues with any of the development builds so far, and I think it's safe to merge it with the Main branch. But I will wait till the next build to do that, which will give me time for some additional testing (just in case). So if you encounter any strange issues or texts that are messed up in formatting or otherwise in the wrong place let me know!

Last but not least I have uploaded a Guide in the Guides section on how you can add your Mods to the Workshop, and a link to Steam Guidelines for user-generated content in the Discussion Board for easier access. So after checking the  Steam Guidelines  and the How-to Workshop Guide please try to upload your mods there and let me know if you encounter any issues! It will be nice fixing them before merging the branches. ;)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1815584432


 EA Build 0235 (Development Branch) 

 Localization Support Additions 

 Added some missing texts in Character Creation & Character Sheet
 Added texts for the Town UI
 Added texts for the Victory/Death Screen
 Added missing Preview Texts (in Enemy, Allies, Actions, Skills, Perks etc)
 Added texts for Enemy & Card Details, 
 Added Combat Log texts
 Adjusted more text fields to be dynamic as the translation character lengths can vary and cause characters to cut out


 Notes to Translator Modders 

To make easier to maintain your localization mods and since the localization.json files don't support comments, I added a fake variable:

notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg

Hi folks,

This build brings several improvements and modding additions in the Adventure Mode, a new (and very highly requested) Action Effect and a much smarter auto-casting system when using the right-click shortcut.

You can read more details in the patch notes below!

 EA Build 0232 

 Balance Changes 

 Enemies can use their Counter Attack ability 1 or 2 times depending their 'Counter Attack' counters. Once they use the ability they lose a 'Counter Attack' counter and may reapply 1 or 2 on their next turn (if they don't have any.)
 Counter Attack Rule changed to: 'Unless attacked with a Ranged Action and as long as this enemy has a 'Counter Attack' counter, they will 'Counter Attack' & lose one of their counters.'


 Perk Related Changes 

 Replaced the perks that were shared between Races & Class.
 If a perk is included in both a Race & a Class .json files only the Race definition will show
 Perks can still be shared between Races or between Classes but each Race/Class combination now has unique perks


 Adventure Mode Changes 

 Whenever clicking on an Adventure Location a confirmation dialog will now appear displaying further info on this location, environment, leylines and a preview of its completion rewards

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/9bf1bb3abb3de684a5cef3837058f14b2998bb68.jpg

 Whenever clicking to travel a Placeholder confirmation dialog will also appear, which will in the future display more info on the target location
 Added a banner indicating that the area is complete. Player can click the 'Return to World Map' button to return back to map or choose a reward for completing the area

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/465eadd4ab4eb36435a19b7610be88d1e55a216d.jpg

 Imports/Exports button in towns and location will display their imported & exported commodities
 Added 34 Commodity Cards. Commodity Cards can be acquired as Adventure Rewards and can be traded in Towns for Farthings
 Added Imports/Exports & Possible Commodity Drops in all adventure locations


 Misc Changes 

 SacrificeAlly:x, will now display as Sacrifice Ally (X). Its previous text will display in the details text box.
 Smarter 'Auto-Casting'

 Armor, Accessory, Cards you Right-Click & Ally Special Abilities that are cast automatically are now smarter and take any active synergies into account
 Autocast cards will now first determine the optimal target of their effects based on active synergies
 If the action is or has become harmful (due to a previous echo action) and an enemy exists they'll target the first enemy instead of the player
 If the action requires to target an ally and an ally exists, the first ally will be chosen as the target
 If the action can't target the first enemy (no enemies are around at the resolution time i.e start of encounter) or can't target an ally (no allies are around) or isn't harmful the card will instead target the player. 
 Right-click handler will switch to Manual mode for any cards with Enemy target if no enemies exist in the battlefield
 Even if the card ends up targeting the enemy, the player still gets all the benefits but the enemy acts as the target. An Echo action will exist as long as that enemy target exists.
 Even if the card ends up targeting an ally, the player will get all positive benefits except healing. An Echo action will exist as long as that ally target exists.
 You can reorder the enemies and allies any time, and in case of potentially harmful armor effects the best time would be before ending your turn
 That doesn't change how you cast cards manually: Feel free to ignore the optimal target (if you know what you are doing) and drag the card in any target you like ;)

 Notes to Modders:

 This gives us more freedom i.e to have Ally Abilities that target allies or Passive equipment designated to target enemies or allies instead of only synergizing the harmful effects
 Echo Actions are not cast automatically, they target their original target, so any harmful effects synergized in Echo Actions that target the player, will still harm the player
 OnDrawCastSelf & OnDrawCastFirstEnemy are also not cast automatically, they will target on draw, their designated target: player or the first enemy (if it exists)



 Location Areas Modding Additions 

You can set Completion Rewards (Cards) for each Adventure Area using "Area_x_Rewards":["Cardname 1","Cardname 2", "etc"],
 You can set a Cover Artwork for each Adventure Area using "Area_x_CoverArtwork":"ArtworkName"
 You can set a Flavor Description for each Adventure Area using "Area_x_Description":"Short Description using \n to indicate new lines"


 New Action Effects  

ChooseOne[CardName]#[Cardname]#[Cardname]#[Cardname]:1, Choose One: [CardName] or [Cardname] or [Cardname] or [Cardname].
 Choose one can be used to choose from 2 to 4 Cards
 i.e ChooseOneCharge#Taunt:1, Choose One: Charge or Taunt.
 i.e ChooseOneFear#Panic Attack#And Now Sleep:1, Choose One: Fear or Panic Attack or And Now Sleep.
 Instead of a card name you can use 'Random Card' 
 i.e ChooseOneRandom Card#Fear:1, Choose One: Random Card or Fear.
 i.e ChooseOneRandom Card#Random Card:1, Choose One: Random Card or Random Card.
 When the effect resolves 'Random Card' is no longer a random but a specific card randomly choosen card, so you can see which card it is & choose it or not.
 There can only be a single 'ChooseOne' keyword per card


 Bugfixes 

 Gravedigger had a typo in his ability Definition, and it wasn't showing/working properly
 Activate Cards & Cards Respace functions weren't called after passive equipment (Armor or Accessory) effects resolved, so cards wouldn't respace or become inactive if the player lacked the AP to use them.
 Allies who persisted across multiple savefiles, could in some case lose their portrait
 Synergy-Modified Optimal Target text in actions could persist in some cases in the next node, even after the synergy modifying it was cleared due to EoT


 EA Build 0232.1 - Addon 

In Adventure Mode: Each Area will now offer various card reward options (in addition to the commodity cards added in main build), and let you expand & enhance your Adventure Deck outside the scope of your class & race.



 EA Build 0232.2 - Hotfix 

In Adventure Mode: Area Reward Equipment was added in the Deck instead of Inventory.

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0231
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg

Hi folks,

If you are in the Main branch this patch is quite large both in size (~100mb) & in content. It contains over 200 new Actions, new mechanics & many changes in existing mechanics.

You can read what's new in 0231 Build below, and my recommendation (if you haven't been following the news) is to also check all the patch notes below and start a fresh run.


EA Build 0228
EA Build 0229
EA Build 0230
 

I didn't discover any bugs so far in my tests, so if you find any let me know. Also now that the dust is settled, I am looking forward for your feedback on this week's cumulative changes both in Balance & Gameplay.

In the meantime & unless something urgent occurs and you need me, I'll be spending the weekend playing Erannorth with Lucy Liu's & Zirkumflex's new Class mods ;)

You can find them in the links below, and of course if you like them don't forget to endorse them! ;)


 Minstrel class by Zirkumflex
The Tempest and the Tinker Classes by Lucy Liu


Have fun!

 Patch Notes - EA Build 0231 

 Bugfixes 

 Reducing the Max HP i.e from a Perk wouldn't refresh right away the Current HP if they were more than the Max HP
 If the ally's ability was a synergy, the preview text wasn't showing the ability description before the ability was activated at least once.
 Cards in Hand wouldn't be adjusted properly to fit in certain cases. They will now adjust both when playing & drawing cards


 Misc Changes 

 Updated Tutorial slide about Perks
 When hovering over a Perk's scroll, the whole perk will highlight for easier distinguishing which perk you are previewing
  Consumables Button was renamed to 'Backpack', and in addition to Consumables will also fetch any Trinket cards you have in your Deck (see details on Trinkets below)


 Action Effects - Additions 

 Conditional & Contingency Trigger Additions

  Echo actions can now be treated as a counter in Conditional Triggers by using [Card Name +*] as [Counter]
  So you can now essentially create any type of counters to test for OnEnemyStatus[Counter]:x, AddEffect[Effect]:x
  i.e OnEnemyStatusAnd Now Sleep +*:1, AddEffectChaotic:8, will Add the Chaotic effect if the enemy has the 'And Now Sleep' counter
  Conditional & Contigency Triggers can now use a Synergy as an Effect but by adding a * in the end of the effect
  i.e AddEffectChaotic*:8, will add a Chaotic Synergy effect instead of the Chaotic effect
  Conditional & Contigency Triggers can now use Spellcraft as an Effect but by adding a # in the end of the effect
  i.e AddEffectSloth#:1, will Spellcraft the Demon 'Sloth' card instead of triggering the "Sloth" effect
  i.e ContingencyEffectPanic Attack#:1, will Spellcraft the Illusionist card 'Panic Attack'

  New Action Type - Trinkets

  You can create Trinket cards by defining them using both Singleton & Trinket keywords i.e Singleton:1, Trinket:1
  Trinkets cost more than other cards of with otherwise same tier (or uses if they are consumables)
  Trinkets can be bought in Towns at the Consumables & Trinkets section
  Trinkets can be quickly accessed by using the 'Backpack' button along with your Consumables (Once per turn discard your hand to fetch the first 4 trinkets or consumables in your Deck)
  There is not a limit how many trinkets and consumables you can have in your Deck, however the Backpack button will only Fetch 4 per turn

 

 EA Build 0231.1 - Minor Hotfix & Addon 

 Bugfixes 

 ReUseArtwork wasn't transfering on the Summoned Ally, after a card with ReUseArtwork had been used to Summon them
 In Buff display a positive Fatigue value will now display with red, as having Fatigue is a negative buff


 Modding Additions 

 Custom Events can now re-use misc vanilla resources (That doesn't change the way you can use your custom graphics)
 Artwork Graphics from the Action Cards using "Discipline/Card Name" in the graphics field. ie. "MainGraphic": "Spelldancer/Courtesan",
 Artwork Graphics from the Enemy Cards using ">Enemy Artwork" in the graphics field. ie. "MainGraphic": ">Admiral Sinclair", (Normal Enemies Artwork filenames don't always match the Enemy Name. You can find them in the EnemyDB)
 Artwork Graphics from the various Background Cards using "*CardBack1-11" in the graphics field. ie. "BackgroundGraphic": "*CardBack1",

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0230 (Development Branch)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg

Hi folks,

Today's build introduces a New Perk Acquisition system, many additions that modders will find useful for their custom card sets and the initial infrastructure to implement imports/exports and commodities in the adventure mode.

I would recommend a fresh run as the old and new perk system aren't meant to play well together. ;)

We are still in the development branch, and unless there are any unforeseen bugs or issues Friday's build should be heading in both branches.

Overall I think, that these cumulative changes we are currently testing, have disrupted the game balance in a positive way, and make things more challenging and interesting (especially in Ironman difficulties).

So I hope you are enjoying these new changes as well, and of course I am looking forward for your feedback!

 EA Build 0230 (Dev Branch) 

 Level Up System Additions & changes

 Level up will now also award +(20 x Level) PP (see Perk System changes below)
 Reduced the amount of XP earned as now they are not reduced whenever you gain Perks


 Perks System changes 

 Locked Perks you can't unlock will now display dark red, and Locked Perks you can unlock will display dark green.
 Perks are passive bonuses and abilities your character can choose to learn by spending earned PP.
 Buying Perks will no longer hinder your level progress
 Every level you get +(20 x Level) PP. They stack and you can spend them whenever you like. However your character can gain a limited amount of PP during their adventures, so choose wisely when and how you'll invest them!
 i.e you get 20 PP at Level 1, then +40 at Level 2, +60 at Level 3 ... etc. If you save them all by Level 3 you'll have 120 PP. You can spend 50 of them any time, and save the rest for a later level.
 A Level 10 Adventurer can in total distribute up to 1100 PP
 Adjusted all Perks costs to match better the new Perks Systems
 You can now define Prerequisite Perks
 ie. [Water Magic Mastery, 120, Water Magic Expertise] instead of [Water Magic Mastery, 120] will add to Water Magic Mastery the prerequisite perk of Water Magic Expertise
 Defining a prerequisite perk is optional and can be ommited.
 Added Prerequisite Perks in any perks that are part of a chain i.e Water Training, Expertise & Mastery etc.
 Perk requirements you pass & fail will appear color-coded when you hover on it to see its description


 Action Card Modding Additions  

You can use these additional (optional) properties when defining actions:


 ReUseArtwork:[string], Instead of using the Action's name for the artwork, you can reuse a vanilla or a custom one in your actions: i.e ReUseArtwork:Broadsword, will set this cards artwork to 'Broadsword.png'

 ie. UserArtwork:1, ReUseArtwork:Fireball, will use or reuse as artwork your custom artwork Fireball.png
 i.e. ReUseArtwork:Spelldancer/Courtesan, will use or reuse the vanilla image Courtesan.png, that is located in the Spelldancer folder. 
 The vanilla file structure is Discipline/Card Name.png, i.e if you click on the Cat Burglar, it'll say Discipline Shadow. Therefore to use his artwork in a card you define: ReUseArtwork:Shadow/Cat Burglar

 Commodity:[string], You can specify that Card is a commodity of a certain type. i.e Commodity:Spice

 Only non-Equipment Actions can be marked as a Commodities
 Commodities are 'minor burdens' in your Deck, you can still discard them, but they can deprive you of a card draw
 Commodities cards can only be given as Event rewards (i.e Loot:Folkswave Coffeebeens) and they can't be converted to skills
 Of course you can craft them in a way that replace themselves i.e also have Focus:1
 You can define the commodity as any type you like, but as long as you do this card will be marked as sellable to merchants [Sell Commodities]
 You can specify a specific price or have the price determined automatically: Commodity Autocalc Price = 75 + (125 x Tier x Merchant Whim)

 SubElement:[string], Action Damage source will display as that of SubElement (for flavor) i.e SubElement:Ice, card Element will remain that of the set Element, i.e Water.

 Damage source remains intact & your enemy will still receive Water damage.
 Element:Ice, will still cause an Error, in ER Ice is a subElement of Water.
 If a SubElement is defined, i.e SubElement:Thunder You still need to define Element i.e Element:Air. Then the card Element will display as Element (SubElement). i.e Air (Thunder), and Damage as [This deals x Thunder Damage]

 SummonRace:[string], Summon's Race will set to that of the SummonRace:[string], i.e SummonRace:Undead

 Added the SummonRace definition in all the Summons. 
 SummonRace will now properly determine the result of various existing effects like Consecrate & Desecrate (and laying the groundwork for future effects to only affect allies of a certain race.)



 New Location.json properties 

 Exports & Imports, are string lists containing a locations exports & imports (should match the tags you have set in your commodities)
 i.e Let's say we have 2 Commodities: Spice & Sugar
 if in a location they are Imports ( "Imports":["Spice", "Sugar"], ) it means that they are not native, have to be imported thus are more expensive (up to 30% more) to obtain than normal
 if in a location they are Exports ( "Exports":["Spice", "Sugar"], ) it means that they are in abudance, thus are cheaper to obtain than normal (down to 30% less)
 This up to/down to 30% increase (or decrease) in the good price, replaces the normal fluctuation rate of (-20% to 20%)


 Misc Changes 

 Added a "Sell Commodities" button in Town, any Commodities you have in Deck will display there and you can sell them


 Bug fixes 

 Selling equipment was displaying the proper (updated) value but was paying player the (former) value in farthings
 Restarting the Mod Manager will also clear the class & race prefs (in case the saved class/race combo no longer exists)
 When the ally was dealing the killing blow even though xp were awarded they weren't display in the combat log

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0229 (Development Branch)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg

Hi folks,

This is a really huge patch. It brings over 150 new Actions in the game that will give you many new allies and different option to expand your tactics.
  
A new 'Consumables' button that allows you once per turn to discard your hand & draw four random consumables from your deck. 

New AI responses and many additional balance changes that I hope will make the game & particular Ironman mode somewhat more challenging.

And many more things you can read in the patch notes below.

This build is currently available only in the Development branch, but hopefully everyone will have it by the end of the week as well.

I hope you'll enjoy these changes! 

Either way, I am looking forward for your feedback to fine-tune things further :)

 EA Build 0229 (Dev Branch) 

 Misc Changes & Additions 

 Added over 150+ New Actions & Summons
 Consumable Related Additions

 Consumables still take up space in your deck and you can draw them instead of a skill card
 However you can now click on the (new) consumables button to: Discard your entire hand & fetch (the first) 4 Consumables (left) in your Drawpile
 Consumables that can be used more than once have the new Singleton keyword. You can only have 1 copy of them in your Deck.

 Added a manual entry for both 'Consumables' & 'Shuffle Deck' buttons.
 Each of the Shuffle Deck & Consumables buttons is only usable once per turn.
 Cards with Cursed, Unravel & Fleeting will not be discarded when using the Consumables or Shuffle Deck buttons
 Core Node Rules (activated through NodeBasedRulesActive): Currently contain only Night Cover & Nocturnal Rules
 Ambush Rules can be activated independently using the game mode properties below


 Balance Changes 

  Ambush Ruleset is now by default active both in Ironman & Pupeteer modes
  Ironman Mode Enemies now have 1.2x more Health.
  Cutthroat Merchants

  Merchants are overall more expensive and will buy your second hand equipment at 1/4 of the price instead of 1/2
  Merchant prices will Fluctuate from -20% less to +20% more of the generated base price with max price = 1500 farthings
  Removed the manual-set prices from (most) vanilla actions & equipment that had them to use the algorithm-generated prices instead
  User manual-set Prices with 'BuyingCost' remain won't be increased neither discounted and will remain unchanged



 New Game Mode Properties 

 "EnemyCanAmbushPlayer":true or false, activate or deactivate the Ambush rules
 "EnemyAmbushChanceAtNight":x, chance to be ambushed during night time
 "EnemyAmbushChanceAtDaytime":x, chance to be ambushed during day time
 "ShowOnlyModeDescription":true or false, if true & a ModeDescription exists only this description will be shown and the run modification ruleset will stay hidden
 ShowOnlyModeDescription, is now set to true in (vanilla) Casual & Normal Modes (Run modifications won't display to be feel less intimidating to new players)


 New Action Keywords, Effects & Improvements 

  Singleton:1, You can only have one copy of this card in your Deck.
  Reaction:1, If this card is still in your Hand after playing a card, Discard it.
  While Fleeting cards last till the end of turn, Reaction cards can survive the end of turn and will last till you play a card. 
  If a player has 2 or more Reaction cards in hand they can only play just 1.
  UnsummonAlly:1, Unsummon Target Ally (need to target an ally)
  OnDrawCreate[Card Name]:x, Upon Drawing a Card with this effect, Create and Draw x [Card Name] copies
  Unlike Spellcraft[Card Name] this effect is resolved instantly as the card gets drawn (whether or not the player ends up playing the card having this effect is irrelevant)
  To prevent flooding hands with infinite copies: 
  Copies created from OnDrawCreate that create themselves, won't replicate further.
  i.e a Card named "Replica", has OnDrawCreateReplica:2. Upon Drawing it you will create two copies of the Card Replica, but the replication will stop there.
  i.e a Card named Replica, has both OnDrawCreateReplica:1 & SpellcraftReplica:1. 
 Upon Drawing it you will create 1 copy of the Card Replica, and the replication will stop there.
 Upon Playing it you will Craft a Replica copy that will cause the OnDrawEffect to trigger, giving an additional copy of Replica. Replication will stop there.
  Additionally there is now a hard cap size in Hand of 20. If the player reaches that cap, no more cards will be created or drawn (whether their equipment, actions or copies) till they discard some of their cards.
  Perks that increase Spellcraft effect should also increase the OnDrawCreate effect (By manually adding the bonus in them i.e Coven Rituals: ModifyEffectSpellcraftCoven Witch:1, ModifyEffectOnDrawCreateCoven Witch:1, etc.)
  OnDrawCastSelf[Card Name]:x, Upon Drawing a Card with this effect, Create and Use on Self x [Card Name] copies
  OnDrawCastFirstEnemy[Card Name]:x, Upon Drawing a Card with this effect, Create and Use on First Enemy x [Card Name] copies
  Text space aside, any number of OnDraw effects can be present in a single card
  SynergyActions:x, can now modify the AP cost of the next action & will display as "Your next Action costs +/-x AP.", for better clarity
  AllyAbility, can now take a Synergy as ability by using the * at the end of the definition. i.e AllyAbilityFocus*:1, will translate to SynergyFocus:1 instead of Focus:1


 New AI Responses & Improvements

 Shield: Whenever the shielded enemy is dealt Damage, instead of reducing their Health remove that many Shield counters. (Shield can absorb any type of Damage even Intense, up to the number of Shield counters.)
 Flank: You lose -2 Defend for each Flank counter in play, at the time this effect resolves. (Penalty won't be readjusted if any enemies flanking you die, but when your next turn starts.)
 (Improved AI Response) Dispel: Enemies will no longer try to dispel you if you don't have any buffs (like Defend, Retribution, Concealment or Empower etc.) active

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0228 (Development Branch)
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

The highlight of this build is the introduction of a new choice wheel, that is currently used to replace the puppeteer event whenever you are about to change a node.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/94bec9dc26c9b7cf09ce53a2273def044b351c2f.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/98e046e358a57f2fc3a390f2199742eaeeae7607.jpg

The puppeteer wheel currently comes with two behaviors: Either all choices can be active, or there is a chance that certain choices are active.

The vanilla Puppeteer and Draft modes will use by default the second behavior, as is the most familiar from similar games: For example in one node, you may be able to choose Encounter, Elite or Camp, and in the next only Encounter or Elite etc.

This wheel can be activated in any game mode by setting a puppeteer handler & the two new game properties. It can also be disabled and you can use the Puppeteer event instead like before, or use the wheel but switch to a different behavior. 

i.e All choice are always active, and your sheer force of will is the only thing preventing you to camp your way to the boss.

All these options are also available through the Game Mode Editor.

The second important addition is a Reshuffle Deck button, which allows you to discard your hand, and then shuffle it along your discard pile back to your deck, so that the next turn you may draw cards from your entire deck.

These changes are currently only available in the Development branch.

You can read more details in the patch notes below!

 EA Build 0228 (Development Branch)  

 Puppeteer Wheel 

 The puppeteer event has been replaced in the vanilla modes that use it (Puppeteer & Draft) with a puppeteer wheel.
 The new puppeteer wheel can either have all choices active or make a chance-based decision which options are active (Encounter is always active)
 For example in one node, you may be able to choose encounter, camp & grimoire but in the next encounter or elite encounter etc.


 New Game Mode Properties 

 "UseVisualPuppeteer":true or false, is this is true AND "OnAdvanceNodeEvent":"Puppeteer", instead of using the puppeteer event will use the new puppeteer wheel
 "VisualPuppeteerIsProcedural":true or false, if false all puppeteer options are active, otherwise all options (except encounter) now have a chance to either be active or inactive, if the visual puppeteer is turn off, this setting has no effect.
 Vanilla Puppeteer & Draft Modes now include both these options by default
 Both options can be set in Custom Game Mode Editor [Fire Event When Changing Nodes], Choose either Visual Puppeteer (All Choices Active) or Visual Puppeteer (Procedural Choices)


 Reshuffle Deck Button 

 There are cases when you want to change your deck and to start accessing the new cards you choose right away but they've been added in the discard pile. 
 Or perhaps what is left at your deck make your hope of survival really thin
 You can use the 'Reshuffle Deck' button above your backpack to discard your entire hand and then shuffle it along with your discard pile back to your deck
 The only drawback is that you won't draw any new cards before your next turn, so use, abuse or not use this button as you see fit ;)


 Bugfixes 

 When resuming the game the player's cards in hand were staying in the drawpile too
 Some Perks were giving a different bonus than the one mentioned


 Default vSync 

 Default vSync is now locked at 60 fps instead of 'Don't Sync'.
 If you had your vSync to either 60fps or at 'Don't Sync' it will now automatically convert to 60 fps. If you had it at 30, it will remain as is.
 If you have a good rig, don't care about the perfomance cost & didn't have any issues with this vSync mode you can still manually set it at 'Don't Sync'.
 Either way I would recommend to check the settings and see if everything else is as you left it ;)


 Build 0228.1 - Hotfix 

 Advancing node with space would leave the puppeteer wheel on

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0227
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

After the introduction of the Special Abilities to our Allies, the next logical step was to (re)introduce the dilemma: Attack? Or use the Special Ability. As in most cases it had become a 'Duh! Of course I'll use the ability'.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/903e79049d317f5ec45d92fa50a3c2f4b842c40d.jpg

To balance out the introduction of these abilities and make summon gameplay a more viable and interesting choice. I've been testing some changes: 

a) Allies are now quite powerful and tough, and the higher their Tier & Card level the more stronger and tougher they become. Summoning them will also cost you a much higher amount of AP (than before) in most cases. But it's a worthwhile investment. They can deal more damage, survive longer & level up faster.

So is attacking better now? The answer I've been aiming for with these changes: is depends. Whether to attack or to use the special ability should no longer be a straightforward choice. Attacking seems the obvious choice. But if you consider that your Ally Special can benefit from the active Synergy, and in what ways this can be beneficial, you'll realize: the possibilities are endless. 

On the other hand the higher the Ally level, the better the ability will be and attacking yields more XP, plus they can deal some serious damage. Hmm.

b) The second change brings a second dilemma: If you could only have 3 allies active at a time, which allies would you summon? Most characters can only have active up to 3 allies, and more specialized classes like Animists, Witches, Necromancers etc can increase this limit up to 5, by investing in two perks: Apprentice Summoner & Expert Summoner. Summoning over your limit will unsummon the leftmost allies, till you end up with allies equal with your limit. 

You can read more details in the patch notes below. 

Now that the allies revision is somewhat more complete, I am looking forward to hear your thoughts & to fine tune the mechanic & the ally abilities further.

 EA Build 0227 
 
 Ally Rules Revision & Other Ally-related changes 

 All Ally/Summon Cards got a (significant) boost in their Power & Health to better match enemies of their Tier and the assorted adjustment in their AP Costs
 Ally/Summon Cards stats will improve more with each card level, than before:

 Power Increase Before: (Empower + Card Level) / 2, Power Increase Now: Empower/2 + Card Level
 Health Increase Before: Empower + Card Level, Health Increase Now: Empower/2 + 2*Card Level

 Most characters can now control up to 3 Allies at a single time. Summoning Card expanded rules text will remind you of this limit: "You can control up to x allies at a time."
 'Apprentice Summoner' & 'Expert Summoner' Perks both will increase this limit by +1 up to the Max of 5 Allies. (Only Animists, Blood Mages, Exorcists, Necromancers, Warlock & Witches have access to these Perks)
 If you attempt to create an ally above your limit the leftmost (first ally in the row) will be unsummoned.
 The same will also happen if you have fewer allies than your limit but the card you use creates 2 or more simultaneously
 You can however rearrange allies to decide which ally gets unsummoned


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/f9a608f26f1448b9cb7f5997ae5767f0d9dce90c.jpg

 Misc UI Improvements 

 In Town UI: Added a Sell Equipment Button in Towns. Selling Equipment won't advance the World clock
 In Character Sheet UI: Clicking on the card image in Skills, Equipment or Deck sections will now display in the Log the Card Info Details text
 In Player's Handbook: Card Details will now include the Card Element


 New Action Effects

notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg

Hi folks,

This patch enhances the changes from the Dev Build 0225 and makes Node-Based Rules optional by turning them into a Game Mode property.

Additionally it adds a new Node-Based rule "Enemy Ambush" and a new optional mechanic "Leylines", which makes the environment affect certain elements in a positive or negative way. In some stages helping you, while in others hindering you.

The only vanilla Game Mode they are currently activated is the Adventure Mode, but you are free to disable them completely or add them to more Game Modes, as those properties can also be set in the Custom Game Mode editor, and further fine-tuned manually.

I hope you'll enjoy these changes! Looking forward for your feedback.

 EA Build 0226 

 Enemy Ambush 

 If the Node Ruleset is active in your Game Mode, Enemies have a chance to Ambush you.
 There is a 30% chance for an Ambush at Night & a 10% chance at Daytime
 This chance will further increase by +10% if the enemies are an 'Elite Encounter'
 When Ambushed:
 
 Enemies won't attack first, they'll however have some significant advantages over the player
 Player starts with -2 Defend per Enemy
 If its night all Enemies will start with at least 2 Concealment counters
 Enemies with the Concealment response always start with 2 to 4 Concealment Counters
 Enemies with the Poison response will always start with 2 to 4 Poison Counters
 Enemies with the Flying response will always start with 1 Flying Counter
 Enemies with the Spiked Armor response will always start with 1 Spiked Armor Counter
 Enemies with the Warcry Response will activate their Warcry
 Enemies with the Gallop Response will activate their Gallop



 Leylines 

 Leylines will affect how certain elements perform on an environmental basis
 Each environment can either offer a bonus (affinity) or a penalty (aversion) towards certain elements
 Light, Dark, Earth, Water, Air, Fire, Astral & Poison Damage Sources are all affected by Leylines in one way or another
 Slashing, Piercing & Bludgeoning (Physical Damage) are not affected by Leylines
 While the aversion & affinity of the environment is fixed, the magnitude can vary on node by node base from -3 to -1 & +1 to +3
 For instance in a Marsh Environment Astral Actions can deal +1, +2 or +3 Damage, but in an Arid (Desert) environment -1, -2 or -3 Damage. etc.
 Leylines will additionally affect Summons of these elements and make them Stronger or Weaker affecting power at 1:1 rate & health at 1:2 rate
 i.e +2 Light Leyline Bonus will grant a +2 Power & +4 Health to a Summon of the Light Element
 Leyline modification will appear in the combat log at the start of each encounter. Additionally if a Leyline ends up modifying an Action's Damage or a Summon's Stats a relevant message will display in the combat log
 Added a new 'Leyline' entry in the codex: "Leyline attunement to certain elements is based purely on the environment. Leylines can provide an affinity boost (or an aversion penalty) to specific Elements, thus helping casters attuned in their element & hindering casters of opposed elements."


 New Game Mode Properties 

 "NodeBasedRulesActive":false or true, Enables or Disables all Node Based Rules except Leylines (Default is false / Disabled)
 "LeylineRulesActive":false or true, Enables or Disables the Leyline Rules (Default is false / Disabled)
 "LeylineAffinityMin":x, & "LeylineAffinityMax":x, (x should be positive & neither 0) can change the default 1 (min) to 3 (max) range to the desired range
 i.e "LeylineAffinityMin":3, "LeylineAffinityMax":5 
 "LeylineAversionMin":x, & "LeylineAversionMax":x, (x should be negative & neither 0) can change the default -3 (min) to -1 (max) range to the desired range
 "LeylineAversionMin":-5, "LeylineAversionMax":-2
 If you like the concept but not the RNG you can set both Min & Max at the same value
 "HoursPassWhileShopping":x, When refreshing (searching a merchant's inventory) in towns this much hours will pass in the world and shops will eventually close (The default value of 0 in vanilla modes, means 1 or 2 hours. Use -1 to Disable this System)
 3 of these properties [NodeBasedRulesActive, LeylineRulesActive, HoursPassWhileShopping] can be set with the Game Mode Editor [Node-Based Rules & Leylines] and [Time Spend Shopping in Towns] sections
 LeylineAffinityMin, LeylineAffinityMax, LeylineAversionMin, LeylineAversionMax can only be set manually


 Misc Changes 

 Improved the Encounter selection algorithm to increase variety within the same group
 Node-based Special Rules will display simply as 'Node Rules'
 Node-Based & Leyline rules will display color coded dark green / dark red, depending if they are beneficial or harmful
 Both Node-Based Rules & Leylines are disabled by default & can be activated on a Game Mode basis
 The only vanilla Mode with them active by default is the Adventure Mode but you can activate them in any game mode


 Bugfixes 

 Disrupting of the Tween animation updates could in some rare cases cause exception errors
 Node special rules where displaying before time advances, showing inaccurate results

notes.notes:
Hi folks,

This build brings a major change in the 'allies' gameplay as well as some minor improvements into the Town UI.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/72e6d9a54964d19fa1cf11443536fe987e0a1465.jpg

The common use for allies so far was to either use them to attack your enemies, or have them guard you & provide a defend & retribution bonus. 

But what if each ally could have its own unique activated ability? 

Perhaps right-click them to (instead) draw you a card or cause a malady to your enemy like freeze them, burn them, or weaken them etc. Giving you more and more tactical options with each ally in play?

I really hope you find this prospect enticing, because that's how your allies work now. ;)

Even though some still provide their old special of Defensive Stance, most allies (Over 90 in fact) will now provide a distinctive special ability once you right-click them.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/7ad72bda461279d76552c55ecc8519796d137319.jpg

So if you have any allies in play in your current save file, is highly recommended to start a new game!

You can read more details in the patch notes below, experiment & of course ask me if you have any more questions about this new mechanic.

But the short version is:

a) You can right-click allies to use their special ability on the first enemy. They get all the negative effects & you all the positive effects.

b) You can drag and drop enemies to re-position them in the battlefield.

c) Using the ally ability counts as using a card, therefore any active synergies are injected into your ally ability.

 Town UI changes

 Town Merchants are now separated to:

 EA Build 0223

I am back from my vacation in Paros and reporting for duty! 

This small patch fixes all the bugs you reported in the forum during my five day absence - let me know if I forgot something - and also implements some minor balance changes based on your suggestions and your frustrations.

During the rest of the July, I will be improving the Adventure Mode, add several new Enemy AI responses and work on the game localization along with various items from the community wishlist. 

 EA Build 0222 

 Bug fixes 

 In certain cases the temporary copy would gain XP instead of the original card

 Equipment could get discarded with some random discard effects when it shouldn't


 Balance Changes 

 All characters start with a +1 in AP/Turn Regeneration Rate

QoL and Misc Changes

 Build 0222.1 - Refinements & Addentum

 "APRegenRateBonusPerLevel":0.2 means you gain +1 AP regen every 5 levels etc.

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0220
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg

Hi folks,

This build adds an additional Game Mode, that some of you have suggested a while back: Draft, and of course you can also convert any game mode to Draft (manually), with the new Game Mode property 'Draft'. 

To spice things up in the vanilla draft mode, I also set your Race/Class Combination to Changeling/Jack of all Trades. So even though the Changeling copies any attributes you set during character creation, you no longer count as a member of your former race & class, and you lose their starting deck, skills & perks.

On the bright side, as Changeling you have access to Vampire, Lycanthrope, Human & Demon cards and as Jack of all Trades you have access to Mercenary, Mystic, Hunter, Shadow, Animist, Exorcist, Witch & Necromancer cards.

So you can draft & create all sort of wacky decks from across 12 Disciplines!

At the end of each encounter you can choose what happens next (similar to the 'Puppeteer' mode.) So you can further draft cards if you need, visit the town to purchase specific cards, or fight your way to the boss.

Aside from the new Draft mode and the assorted game properties, I also made some (major) balance changes in the Enemy Database and the Enemy Level up Algorithm. 

This change (I hope) will provide you with a more challenging yet smoother difficulty curve in Ironman & its variants, while leaving the Casual & Normal Modes (mostly) untouched for the Casual Players who don't like min/maxing their characters but still want a fair share of challenge.

I am looking forward of course to hear your thoughts on these changes!
 
In the meantime have fun!

 Balance Changes 

 Increased the Enemy Level Ranges the player can meet [ from (SC - 2, SC + 1) to (SC - 1, SC + 2), where SC = Stages Cleared]
 Increased Normal Encounters in Normal from 2 to 4, to 3 to 4
 Increased Elite Encounters in Ironman from 3 to 4, to 3 to 5
 Increased Elite Lvl Difference in Puppeteer from +1 to +2, Elite Encounter from 3 to 5 to 4 to 5 & Enemy Health was set to 100%, Enemy Power to 90%
 Slightly changed the algorithm that generates higher level enemies: Increased HP & Power, Slightly higher positive resistances, Negative resistances (weaknesses) will no longer become worse.  
 Slightly reduced Damage Range of most Enemies, which along with their new level up algorithm should result in a smoother difficulty curve
 Several Enemy Races are now immune to the 'Kill' effect
 Cards Changed: Final Death (Hunter)


 New Game Mode Properties 

 "ModeDescription": Display a plain text description of the Game Mode above rule modifications.
 "Draft": true or false, if true the player will open 12 Grimoires of 4 cards each and pick 12 cards.
 "ForceClass":"Class", if set will keep the customized attributes but change the player's class to the chosen class
 "ForceRace":"Race", if set will keep the customized attributes but change the player's race to the chosen race
 Forced Class & Race don't have to be a playable Classes or Races. As long as the class has a Starting Weapon Equipped you are good to go. (Deck, Skills & Perk can all be blank)


 New Game Mode 'Draft' 

 Player's Race is set to 'Changeling' & Class is set to 'Jack of all Trades' 
 This combination offers no Deck, initial Skills or Perks but access to all Basic Race & Class Disciplines
 Upon game start the player must draft 12 cards to add to their deck
 The rest of the mode rules are Ironman with the Puppeteer event firing each time the node changes.
 You can create your own custom draft modes (manually) just add "Draft":true, to any game mode


 Misc QoL improvements 

 Added a message in the combat log displaying the AP player restored at the start of their turn  
 Added a Codex Entry for the Card's Potential: "If a Card's Potential is lower than the Target's level, Negative effects like Stun, Vulnerable, Bewitch etc. won't affect them. A Card's Potential is = Your Level + Card Level + Empower Bonus."
 The Card's potential will now show in the Card Details accessible via the Card Info button
 Added text description in all vanilla game modes to better describe what they are about and who are aimed at


 Bugfixes 

 Conditional & Contingency effects were not improving as the Card level increased
 Conditional, Contingency weren't counting as part of the card when calculating the damage necessary to break counters (i.e Bewitched, Frozen & Immobilized) 
 Some effects weren't counting as a damage source when calculating the damage necessary to break counters (i.e Bewitched, Frozen, Immobilized)
 Whenever counters were removed from an enemy ie. due to damage breaking immobilized, only 1 counter was removed instead of the x damage-depended counters

What this mode does, is that it simply let's you choose your next node (among a list of choices) every time you are about to change your node.  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/f3cecee633037d4117625dcf9979785eacc036bb.jpg

You want to fight an elite encounter? Camp? Look for a Random Event? You can choose exactly how the Stage will play out and follow your own Path to the Boss. Or just press 'space' to skip choosing & fight a normal encounter.

Now the thing to keep in mind with this mode (its vanilla implementation), is that even though it initially appears modded in your favor (less Enemy HP & Power, Starting at Level 3, free access to Camp & Towns) as long as there are less than 2 enemies, every 2 rounds, enemy reinforcements will arrive. So that's 3 more spawns to deal with. Which won't be as hard to deal in the first stages, but will get progressively harder later on and result in longer Encounters ;)

Of course, you are not only free to create your own 'Puppeteer' game modes, but to also attach any other event you like in this new Game Mode property. Perhaps just the option to Camp, or to Gather Herbs or any other activities you can think, you can probably mod it. 

Now while nothing should break in the main game (any other modes), this new game property (while active) changes the core functionality of the game loop, and it may still have issues I couldn't detect while testing. 

So let me know if you encounter any strange behaviors while playing the vanilla or your custom Puppeteer modes. And your thoughts on how to make this mode more exciting ;)

 New (experimental) Game Mode 'Puppeteer' 

 Each time you are about to advance a Node the 'Puppeteer' Event is called instead
 This Event lets you choose your next node
 You can choose between a Normal Encounter, Elite Encounter, Random Event, Merchant Event, Camp, Town or to Draft a new Action
 Camp & Town both will cost you 1 Ration & have a 10% chance to trigger a random encounter after you arrive
 Draft allows you to pick up to 3 new Actions out of 12, but for each tome you wish to open you need to pay 2, 4 & 8 AP
 The last node can't be changed and is always the Boss
 Vanilla Puppeteer uses an easier variant of the Ironman mode with overall more but weaker enemies and a quite high reinforcements rate
 You can convert any game mode (including a Sandbox mode) to 'Puppeteer' by setting in the Game mode: "OnAdvanceNodeEvent":"Puppeteer"
 You can also customize the options in 'Puppeteer' Event by editing the Puppeteer.json event, or just provide your own OnAdvanceNodeEvent


 New Game Mode Properties

 "ReinforcementsToCall":x, The number of additional enemies to call as reinforcements. If unset (most vanilla modes) defaults to 1.
 "OnAdvanceNodeEvent":"EventID", If the player is about to advance a node, instead call EventID and don't advance the node.

 After this Event is called, the next time the player attempts to advance node they'll do so normally
 After the Player advance in node, the next time they attempt to advance node the OnAdvanceNodeEvent is called once more
 So what this does is changing the advance node behavior to alternate between calling this event and actually advancing the node
 OnAdvanceNodeEvent is disabled while exploring Dungeons, Caves or Bandit Camps
 When the 'Puppeteer' event is used as OnAdvanceNodeEvent all nodes become questionmarks.
 Both properties can only be set manually by editing the game mode .json files. You can find the Puppeteer.json in the Game Modes folder, and use it as a reference.



 Misc Changes 

 Added scrolling in the Event Choices section
 Events can now have up to 12 Choices, but only the first 4 are visible without scrolling.


 Bugfixes 

 Renaming the misspelled "Shutter Weapon" to "Shatter Weapon" in 0217.2 broke the Mercenary Skill List in the Character Sheet


 Build 0219.1 - Hotfix 

 While using Custom Stage Sets (in Puppeteer Mode), the length of the Stage was set incorrectly, teleport the player from mid-stage at the dungeon entry.


 Build 0219.2 - Hotfix/Addon 

 Fixed some typos in the 'Puppeteer' event
 Added a few presets for Reinforcements & OnAdvanceNodeEvent handlers in the Game Mode Editor
