https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg

Hi folks, 

This patch concludes (for the time being) the new round of Action Effects additions. There are plenty of them and many are composite (which means you can combine them with non-composite keywords and create different effects) so lots of things to test and re-familiarize with. You can find them all together in the Community Modding Guide (Action Effects - Part 3).

Aside from the new effects there are many changes to be aware: 9 Disciplines got their initial makeover, I added an extra upgrade level for all cards, a new Card Tier (T6) for Modders to use, new game mode properties and an Enemy Reinforcement system, to keep you from abusing the upgrade system (the wrong way). You know you can just edit your save files right?

So many things to test & many things that can go wrong! I would highly recommend to start a new character if you are currently playing one of the revised classes/races, but it's not really necessary.

Looking forward for your feedback and let me know if you encounter any issues! Have fun!

 Balance Changes 

 Non-Elite Enemy Encounter for Casual is set to 2 to 3 Enemies (was 1 to 3)
 Non-Elite Enemy Encounter for Normal is set to 2 to 4 Enemies (was 2 to 3)
 Revised/Boosted/Nerfed the following Card Sets (so much, you probably won't recognize them. Well not really. But you get the point) 
 Human, Vampire, Lycanthrope, Demon, Mercenary, Shadow, Mystic, Hunter, Animist got their initial makeover. All changes are still a subject for thorough play testing by both you & I. So nothing is finalized yet...


 Enemy Reinforcements 

 Every 3 turns and if there are less than 3 enemies in the battlefield a new enemy will now join the encounter (if such enemy can be found in the DB)
 A relevant message will appear in your Combat Log: "Oh no! Enemy Reinforcements!"


 New Game Mode Properties 

  "EnemyReinforcementsEveryXTurns":x, Every x turns the encounter lasts enemies of the same faction will join the combat 
  "ReinforcementsIfEnemiesLessThan":x, Reinforcement will only be called if enemies are less than x
  You can (manually) adjust both values in your game modes, if no values are set in either (all vanilla modes) both will default to 3
 If you want to disable the Reinforcements system set the x in "EnemyReinforcementsEveryXTurns":x very high i.e 30


 Card Tiers & Upgrades Changes 

 Added Support for Tier 6 cards (there aren't though any Tier 6 actions in the game)
 Maximum Card Level is now Tier + 1
 Equipment Reqs changed to Levels 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 & 11 (From 1,3,6,9,12)
 Tier 5 now unlocks at Mastery 90 & Tier 6 at 120
 Tier 0 can upgrade up to Level 1, Tier 1 up to Level 2 ... Tier 6 up to Level 7
 If after upgraded a card can still be upgraded, its dots (representing the card levels) will now glow purple
 Once a card reaches its maximum level it will get an extra dot and all of them will now glow in orange (like before)


 Contigency Action Triggers 

 If the Caster has more (or less) [Status] than x, this Action gains [Effect] y
 Notes to Modders:

 Similar to Conditional Action Triggers but they instead trigger based on the PC HP, AP & Level values. There is a simple two step declaration:
 OnCasterStatus[Status]:[x], ContigencyEffect[Effect]:[y]
 Caster Status can be HPLess, HPMore, HPOverHalf, HPBelowHalf, APLess, APMore, APOverHalf, APBelowHalf, LevelLess, LevelMore
 Caster Status can be [Attribute]More or [Attribute]Less ie. CharismaMore, ResilienceLess etc.
 Less/Below is true only if the checked value is less, while More/Over if the checked value is greater or equal
 i.e OnCasterStatusHPOverHalf:1, ContigencyEffectSacrifice:5 will add a Sacrifice Effect if Player's HP >= 50%
 i.e OnCasterStatusCharismaMore:20, ContigencyEffectLust:5 will add a Lust Effect if Player's Charisma is more than 20
 Only one contigency pair can be present in the card
 Unlike Conditional Action Triggers that only target Enemies, Contigency can additionally target the caster or an ally
 A (single) Conditional & a (single) Contigency Trigger can both be present in the same card



 Misc Quality of Life Improvements 

 Towns will now display Rations & Player's HP & AP
 The button to buy rations in town will deactivate if you have (or once you reach) the carry capacity of 4 Rations
 Whenever an active Synergy converts the optimal target to Enemy or Ally, all Cards in hand will change their 'Optimal Target' text to reflect that, but the color will remain intact to indicate that this a temporary change.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/1a98ec5498dec266215a3fe1ffb7c6fb66a11fc1.jpg

 New Equipment Slots - Armors & Accessories 

 Having an equipped Armor or Accessory is optional
 Armors & Accessories go into your inventory and can be freely switched at any moment. 
 Their effects trigger at the start of your next turn. (Are automatically used (cast on Player) every turn, at the Start of the Player's turn)
 Order of casting is Armor then Accessory. 
 This is really important: When using both an Armor & an Accessory, the Armor Synergies will trigger in the Accessory Card (...and any damaging synergies will harm *you*!)
 Equipped Armor & Accessory cards have an AP upkeep equal to their AP cost. AP cost is paid (reducted from your AP pool) every turn they activate (whether you can pay it or not!)
 Equipped Armor & Accessory cards incur concentration penalty (Count as Actions used towards Fatigue)
 Updated 'Equipment' help text to include info on Armors & Accessories
 Some Equipment mentions that they Synergize "Health". That's not a typo. They affect the 'Health' of the next Summoning card not your HP.
 Some new Summons have Health 0. That's also not a typo & they can only be successfully summoned after 'Health' has been Synergized to them or you are Empowered.
 Notes to Modders:

 Armor is declared as Slot:2 & Accessories as Slot:3, both also need to be Persistent:1
 Neither should have Echo, as they are cast every turn either way and upon unequip their effect should end!



 Misc Changes, Additions & Bugfixes 

 Added 80 new Action Cards (mostly Armor & Accessories Equipment)
 Attributes help text wasn't mentioning 'Poison' damage source governing attributes


 EA Build 0206.1 

 When resuming game (passive) Equipment effects (Armor & Accessory) weren't triggering
 Whenever you were changing node (passive) Equipment effects would trigger before the debuffing step, debuffing in the process
 Changed the trigger order to Echo Actions => Armor => Accessory, to make (passive) Equipment more reliable. Echo synergies will now get attached to your (passive) Equipment and not the other way around. This will significantly reduce the chances of accidental self harm. But you still need to be careful. ;)
 Added 19 new Actions Cards

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0204 (Both Branches)
notes.notes:
Ever wanted to make your own Stages and enrich them with your own stories and custom events, but not in a random procedural fashion? 

Maybe slow things down, add more choices and make things less linear. Perhaps by having a custom event every other node that allows you to choose the node after it. Hey! Do you want to fight the elite or get for free three actions?

Or make things more combat oriented. Drop all events and have elite fight after elite fight.

Or maybe have the first 10 nodes filled with dead adventurers or a custom event that lets you pick cards to create something like a draft mode and pick actions and gear for the entirety of your next run?

Well now you can do all these.

This build includes all the tools you need to create even more unique Game Modes ;)

 Moddable Custom Stages 

 You can now define Custom Stage Sets as Mods
 Each Stage Set is declared as a .json file and needs to be placed in ../Content/Stages or in ../Mods/[Your Mod]/Stages
 Each Stage Set can contain up to 20 User Defined Stages, If the Game Mode contains more than 20 Stages, 21+ Stages will get procedurally generated
 All .json files in the above folders will be loaded to the StagesDB, but will be used only if the Game Mode makes use of this Custom Set
 You should always include ONLY one 'DungeonEntry' & 'Boss' nodes at Start & End of Stage
 Killing a Boss is necessary in order to advance to the next Stage
 Other nodes you can include are: Encounter, Elite, Camp, Intersection, CaveIntersection, BanditCampIntersection, DungeonIntersection, Town, Treasure, Event, Merchant or a Tale ID
 Stage Nodes can have as value a Tale ID, the icon will appear as a questionmark but the chosen tale will trigger once visiting this node.
 Since at this point the Environmental Graphics can't be changed it's advisable to use 'Intersection', and let the StageManager decide if this is a Cave, Bandit Camp or Dungeon
 Inside the stages folder you'll find a CStageTemplate.json file to use as a template, you are free to add as many nodes you like in each of the 20 custom stages, and use as many of them as you like in your Game Mode. i.e You may only want to edit & use the 3 first. In this case you can leave the Stages 4 to 20 as they are, since they won't be used. But if your mod user decides to add extra stages in their run, nothing will break.


 New Game Mode Setting 

 UseCustomStageSet:[Set name], if defined will use the Custom Stage Set named [Set name] instead of the vanilla procedurally generated Stages.
  When using a 'CustomStageSet' in a game mode you should never set a 'StartingStageLength' and won't make much sense to set a 'StartingNode'.
 On a different note, the StartingNode can now also be a Tale ID


 Additions and Enhancements in the Tales system 

 Tales can be chained by using the Tale ID as the function to execute (this will work if there isn't already a function of the same name)
 Current functions are: Camp, Rations, Chest, Backpack, Pouch, Grimoire, Journal, Merchant, Town, Cave, Bandit Camp, Dungeon, Path & Onwards
 i.e "Choice_1_ExecuteFunction":"Adventurer Corpse I", will load the 'Adventurer Corpse I' story when you click Choice 1
 When chaining Tales its not necessary for the choice to has its own text, as the chained tale loads instantly, so the choice uses the next tale narrative as its outcome
 This way you can write individual scenes and chain them together to create a 'choose your own adventure' story right now. But there will probably be a more efficient way for that in the future.
 It's recommended when creating large stories by chaining tales, to create each of these large stories as a separate mod.
 Level:x & Stage:x can be used as checks in the Tale & Choice 'requirement' fields
 Level:x, check is passed if the player level is higher/equal than x
 Stage:x, check is passed if the current stage is higher/equal than x
 NextNode:[Node] can be used as a choice reward to change the next Stage node into [Node] which can also be a Tale ID. ie. NextNode:Merchant, will summon a merchant in the next node, and NextNode:Adventurer Corpse I, a dead adventurer to loot.


 Bugfixes 

 Flight status would break at HP/3 instead of HP/2
 Card XP gain function was called twice on 'Self' cards
 Enemy Modification rules was displaying their values as +x% which was inaccurate, it now instead displays as x%


 EA Build 0204.1 

 Bugfixes 

 When an Action fizzles has damage output but deals 0 damage for any reason (low proficiency, flying enemy etc.)	the message will now simply display that Action dealt 0 damage.
 Damage roll will only appear if either Damage or Intense Damage, or Split Damage exist and it's not converted to 0 due to low proficiency or flying enemy etc.
 Damage output will only Split (if there is a reason to) only if it haven't been set to zero for any reason (low proficiency, flying enemy etc.)


 Tales System Additions 

 Encounter:[Random] & [RandomElite] can be used as choice reward to trigger a random Normal or Elite Encounter
 Encounter:[Enemy - Lv x], can be used as choice reward to trigger encounter with a specified enemy (Enemy needs to exist in DB). i.e Order Recruit - T2, can be found from Level 2 to 12 (Non-Boss Enemies have a DB entry from Level [Tier] till Level [Tier + 10]).		 For example you can use "Choice_1_Reward":"Encounter:Order Recruit - Lv 2, Encounter:Order Recruit - Lv 3" to summon 2 Order Recruits to fight the player, if they take this choice. But "Encounter:Order Recruit - Lv 1" wouldn't have any effect as this enemy doesn't exist.
 You can see the Enemy Tiers in the compendium and calculate their level range
 When triggering encounters from Events, the event box will hide, and choice outcome will display in the combat log.


 EA Build 0204.2 

 Flamemare and a couple more enemies were factionless, creating (consistent) encounters with just them. It's still possible to get a full encounter of them, but it should be rarer.
 Slightly reduced Flamemare's Power & Health, Increased Tier to 5 from 4


 EA Build 0204.3

 Balance Changes 

 Reduced Empower bonus in Concealment
 Slightly Reduced values/Nerfed Actions with the Kill effect


 Bugfixes 

 Air Conduit was incorrectly granting +3% concealment instead of the mentioned +5%


 Tales System Additions 

 All reward keywords can be turned into chance for a 'reward' by prepending 'Chance>x>' before the [Reward]
 i.e "Choice_1_Reward":"Craft:Firebolt, Chance>25>Encounter:Random"
 Will give player a 'Firebolt' in hand, but also has a 25% chance to trigger a random encounter 
 i.e "Choice_1_Reward":"Craft:Firebolt, Chance>50>Craft:Firebolt, Chance>25>Cast:Firebolt"
 Will give player a 'Firebolt', adds a 50% chance to get an additional 'Firebolt', and a 25% chance to have a Firebolt blow on Player's face (with stats as if casted by the Player)


 Card Text Modifications 

 'Equipment (Type) Requires Level x', when you don't meet the equipment requirements will now appear as: Equipment (Type - Lvl x)

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0203 (Both Branches)
notes.notes:
If you've been following the development branch, this build concludes the initial implementation of the Tales system and also implements an improved Summon Save state. It doesn't add yet any new events to the game.

For everyone in the main branch, this build brings it up to speed with all the latest development builds 0200 => 0203. Main features being the Game Mode Editor, the new Events system & all the changes below. So make sure to check all the relevant patch notes, if you haven't already, to get up to speed. ;)

 Enhanced Summon Save State 

 All Summoned Allies are saved regardless if they are unique or not
 Non-unique Summon names may receive a different number upon load i.e your Zombie:3, might become Zombie:1 if former Zombie:1 & 2 are dead. All other stats will be as saved.


 Initial Implementation of the Tales System & Misc Changes 

The initial implementation of the Tales system is complete and you can start creating your own events that can harm or benefit the player. 

Note though, that all events can be (currently) skipped by hitting the [Spacebar] or Ending your turn. That won't be eventually the case, and you'll be able to mercilessly throw the PC into a bottomless pit trap. But for now the events essence isn't to cause an inescapable hazard but instead to give the player a choice to get something, at the cost of something else. At least that's the direction the vanilla events will be heading. You are free to use and abuse the new system to your heart's content. I'll be updating later today the Modding Guide with information how to create your new events, and play them right away. Which is really easy and straightforward to do ;)


 Tale window shifted up & Loot window shifted down, to both be able to read the choice outcome & claim your reward. 
 Only Tales with 'AutoIncludeInEventNode:true' are automatically added to the event node and have 1 out 5 chance to appear when visiting the event node.
 Looting Event has 4 out 5 chance to appear when visiting the event node, and will also be used as a fallback when there aren't any Unique events in the database.
 Auto-included Tales can be either unique or non-unique (As defined by their 'Unique' value). Non-Unique tales may reappear, while unique tales will appear only once.
 Unique tales have a priority to appear, if the one picked randomly is already played, or its requirements aren't met then a non-unique tale will be used instead.


 Giving rewards to the player 

Each choice reward field can accept:

a) the name of a perk as value. 

 Perks can be awarded only once, so make sure they are unique and not part of a class or race perk list.
 Perk description is appended in the story outcome text.
 The Perk XP unlock cost is ignored and has no effect, but it still need to be set when declaring the perk.


b) Craft:Cardname, to craft and give player a copy of Cardname

 i.e Craft:Reanimate, will give player a copy of Reanimate in hand
 Card can be an equipment card, but that won't equip that equipment or add it to the player's inventory


c) Cast:Cardname, to use Cardname on the Player

 i.e Cast:Omega, will summon the Omega unique companion

	
d) A comma separated list of all the above

 i.e Morheliss Blessing, Cast:Omega, Craft:Fireball, Craft:Fireball
 Choice will grant: the Morheliss Blessing perk, Cast Action 'Omega' and craft 2 Fireball Copies, (not that the particular combo makes any sense, but you get the point)


 Restricting choices based on player's stats & attributes 

 Each choice requirement field can accept: 

a) Race:[Race], will check if the Player is of chosen race
b) Class:[Class], will check if the Player is of chosen class
c) Gender:[Gender], will check if the Player is of chose gender
d) [Attribute]:x, will check if the Player's [Attribute] is higher/equal to x. ie. Strength:15
e) A comma separated list of all the above

  i.e Race:Vampire, Strength:20, Agility:20
[*[ Choice will become non interactable if the player fails in any of the checks.
Unique Tales can also have a 'Requirements' field, and the player needs to pass their requirements before the tale appears

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0201 (Development Branch)
notes.notes:
We all know that ER is moddable, and that you can customize everything by editing plain text files, but still for some this might still feel scary. 

What if I break something?

Nah, let's just wait till someone else mod this & that for me. 

Well you can't really break anything. Bad mods can just be deleted, Steam can restore your game files and everything will be just fine. But still. 

What if you could create as many new Game modes you'd like just by selecting values in dropdown menus? And have them exported automatically as a Mod you can then activate/deactivate, expand with more game modes and delete when you are bored of it?

Well now you can, and the difficulty/balance of your game is in your fingertips, even if you are hesitant or just bored to mod things. ;)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/927a4d4d5d46243b9ce8927299ac05aeecf06da4.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/e565d1c72528fa62e4847a3d4d402b43faa874b1.jpg


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/8a4c7ca13c2040ddaa1dc500d1c0194233fa8c6e.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/b69351cd8ad1bbc12eab8dac250bbee0c6008f26.jpg

 Custom Game Mode Editor 

 A visual tool that creates new Game Modes as Mods.
 The game modes are playable right away. But optionally you can then edit their .json files in a text editor to fine-tune them further. As I can't provide every possible imaginable value in a dropdown, and input fields would beat the purpose of having a visual tool.
 You can create any number of Game Modes you wish (within reason)
 You can specify the Game Mode name & it will be saved along with all your Game Modes in the Mod folder: 'User GameModes'
 You can overwrite your custom Game Modes by specifying the same Game Mode name
 You can overload Vanilla Game Modes by specifying their Game Mode name ie. Casual
 You can delete and deactivate the User GameModes mod from the Mod Manager
  Game Mode Properties that can be adjusted:

 How many Enemies will appear in Normal Encounters
 How many Enemies will appear in Elite Encounters
 Modify Enemies Health Multiplier
 Modify Enemies Power Multiplier
 Adjust which Enemies have Resistances
 Modify Enemies Resistances Multiplier
 Max Elite level in comparison to current stage
 Start adventure at higher level
 Change your XP multiplier
 Adjust your starting HP
 Adjust your starting Wealth
 Adjust Stage Length & Initial Stage
 Adjust Stage bonus rewards upon completion
 Specify the first node you'll visit
 Adjust or Disable the Fatigue System
 Enable Permadeath or Specify save retain penalties
 Use custom Draw Phase rules
 Enable & customize a Discard phase



 Wait! This mean I can cheat! Create for example a 3 Stage Run with super-easy opponents and get loads of tokens & mastery?

Well yes. Or you could just edit your save files, way faster and easier. 

It's your game. Mod it, break it, make it more challenging, super easy, impossible. Whatever is fun for you. I am here to provide the tools not to judge you ;)

 New Moddable Game Mode Properties 

 EnemyHealthMultiplier x: Multiply enemy health by x (float: i.e 0.5 sets to half, 1.2 sets to 20% higher etc.)
 EnemyPowerMultiplier x: Multiply enemy power by x (float). ( Enemy Max Damage = Power & Min Damage = Power/2 )
 EnemiesWithResistance x: x is Vanilla, Boss or None. Vanilla will leave the resistance system as is. Boss will remove resistances from non boss enemies. None will remove resistances from everyone. (Both positive & negative)
 PositiveEnemyResistanceMultiplier x: Multiply positive enemy resistances by x (float)
 NegativeEnemyResistanceMultiplier x: Multiply negative enemy resistances by x (float)
 Enemy modifications are per game mode basis & they will appear modified in Enemy Compendium once the game mode that modifies them is started.
 The final results of these calculations a rounded down to integer values. But Enemy Health & Power can never drop below 1.
 Modmanager will reset when restarting or soft-restarting the game and Enemies will set back to their original stats


 Bugfixes 

 Enemy AI Response Cards will now Stay visible for [Enemy Attack Speed] + 0.3s. Default is 1.2s Attack Speed & 1.5s for the AI Response Cards (Before it was 1.5s regardless your Attack Speed Setting)
 Game Mode Property "StartingNode" wasn't working for other nodes other Town.

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0199 (Development Branch)
notes.notes:
Most of the recent Patches have been all about buffing the Player, customizable Attributes, better Level up, New Races, Classes, Actions &  Action Effects, Perks etc. All the while, the poor monsters were feeling really neglected and rightly so. Well it's time for their vengeance!

Difficulty should now be much closer to the recommended Mastery levels, but of course you are free to mod and fine-tune things to your liking and skill level. 

I have updated the Modding guide to include the new keywords available for defining and customizing Game Modes, and the archetype's section with the new AI keywords you can use in your custom enemies.

I'll explain them briefly below:

 New Enemy AI Behaviors 


 Flyby Attack 


 Flying Enemy will lose a Flying Counter to Attack twice this turn.
 When enemies use the Flyby Attack they will receive Retribution damage, but only once.
 Enemies won't use Flyby Attack if they have 1 or less Flying Counters
  (This AI response doesn't create a status effect icon, just a floating indication card & combat log message)
 Wyverns & Demons have Flyby Attack


  Spiked Armor  


 Unless targeted with a Ranged Action, this enemy will deal Retribution Damage once attacked. This Damage is Intense & proportional to the Action's Damage or Action's Level.
 Stunned, Frozen & Entangled enemies still deal this retribution damage to the player, as Spiked Armor is a passive effect
 If the Action has a Direct single Target Damage effect ie. Wrath, Damage, Poison, Intense etc, 25% of that Damage is dealt back to the caster as Intense Retribution Damage. Bonus modifiers like Double, Sneak Attack etc won't apply. 
 Multicast will also trigger Spiked Armor as it individually targets each target.
 If the Action doesn't deal Damage, the Retribution Damage returned is equal to Action Level + 3.
 Ulniir, Devils, Wyverns & Zreeblik Race and Death Knight Class Enemies have Spiked Armor.


  Counter Attack  


 Unless targeted with a Ranged Action, this enemy will always Counter Attack (using their default attack card) each and every time they are attacked.
 Multicast will also trigger counter attack as it individually targets each target.
 This attack obviously won't receive player's retribution but can be resisted & defended.
  Immobilized (Stunned), Bewitched, Entangled & Frozen enemies won't Counter Attack, as Counter Attack is an active effect.
  Blademaster Class Enemies have Counter Attack.


  Warcry  


 All Enemies in the Battlefield gain x Rage Counters, where x is equal to half the Warcry caster's level or up to a Max value of +3 for level 6+.
 Once the enemy allies act their Rage counters will either drop by 1 if they use a different AI response than Enrage, or increase by +1 as Enrage is now a valid response even on AIs that normally don't Enrage.
 Each enemy can use Warcry only once.
 Ulniir Race & Battlerager Class Enemies have Warcry.


  Illusory Copy  


 Enemy will attempt to create a copy of themselves that is 1 level lower than them.
 If such a level exists a clone of them will be created.
 Each Copy will further attempt to copy themselves.
 Devileye, Yakt & Sylph Race and Illusionist Class Enemies have Illusory Copy.


 Dispel  


 Enemy will attempt a level-based roll to debuff all active buffs in Player (defend, retribution, empower etc.)
 They can attempt Dispel again only once all their Dispel counters are gone.
 Mystic is the only Enemy class with this ability.



 Misc Changes & Additions 


 Ranged keyword now reads: 'Ranged Actions can harm Flying Targets, won't provoke Counter Attack or receive damage from Spiked Armor.'
 Flying enemies will lose all they flying counters if they attempt to act with 50% or HP, or if they get Stunned, Entangled or Frozen.
 Stun, Entangle & Freeze effects can only affect flying targets if they are part of a Ranged Action.
 Rage will now stop increasing once it reaches 5 counters, and when it does, all rage counters will get removed. Depending how enemy got it in the first place, a new sequence of rage may start over or not.
 Negative Statuses applied on Enemies & AI Responses can now be searched in the Terms Codex.


 Bugfixes 


 Drain effect will no longer trigger if the Action isn't ranged & the enemy is flying
 Neutralized Effects in cards due to positive or negative perk bonuses will no longer appear.   Neutralized effects aren't subject to Evolution or Empower and will never trigger or reappear in the card unless the Effect (defined) value + the Perk Bonus/Penalty becomes greater or less than 0, or are re-synergized into the card.

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0198 (Development Branch)
notes.notes:
New Enemies, Flying Behavior & Ranged Actions/Equipment 

 New Action Effect: Ranged.
 Ranged property allow Actions to damage directly enemies with flying.
 Added the Ranged keyword to all relevant Actions.
 New AI Response: Flying
 While an enemy is Flying, they can only be harmed (directly) by Actions with the 'Ranged' property, and their attacks won't trigger retribution counterattack.
 Flying enemies can still receive Bewitch damage from Allies, Chain damage, AoE damage etc. Additionally, when any Stun, Entangle or Frozen effect resolves in the target, their Flying Status will be temporarily removed.
 Enemies who lose over 50% of their HP can no longer fly.
 Demon, Devileye, Insect & Wraith Enemies have flying.
 Separated all enemies into factions, to create more varied & challenging encounters.
 Added 30 new Enemies.


 New Moddable Game Mode Properties 

 DiscardPhase:[true/false], Enforces a (random) discard phase at End of Turn (Default, if omitted is false)
 DiscardDownTo:x, if DiscardPhase is true, Player will discard at random down to x cards at End of Turn (Default, if omitted is down to 0 => Entire Hand)
 DrawPhase:x, At the start of the new turn, Player will draw +x Cards in addition to their equipment. Unless used with a Discard phase player will keep stockpiling more cards each turn. 
(Default, if omitted or is set to 0 is to draw up to the vanilla intellect based [Hand] size value.)


 Misc Additions & Changes 

 Before saving the game progress, a fresh hand and player's equipment is first drawn
 'Fatigue' & 'Discard' Action effects won't increase through out the Action's Evolution & will remain fixed to their set value
 Focus & Invoke will allow you to draw or create cards, as long as (at the time of their casting) you have 6 or less cards in your hand.
 Focus x will now read: Draw x Cards. Effect is ignored if you already have 7+ Action Cards.
 Invoke x will now read: Create & Draw x Random Actions. Effect is ignored if you already have 7+ Action Cards.
 AI Defensive Stance, Concealment & Incorporeal response hover help wasn't mentioning that they don't trigger retribution counterattacks.
 When choosing a Race & Class, your mastery with it, will appear inside parenthesis in the overview box. i.e Lycanthrope (+117) etc.



 EA Build 0198.1 

 Flying enemies will get 3 counters once the effect triggers, then each turn loose a counter. This way you still have an opening to kill them without any ranged cards, or reduce their health once they lose their last counter and before they get their 3 next counters.
 Drain Soul, didn't have a combat log message
 Giant Beetle had the wrong artwork
 Empower wasn't reducing by -1 after ending your turn with enemies present. (when no enemies were present it was properly completely debuffing)

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0197 (Both Branches)
notes.notes:
New Level up System 

Level up will no longer increase your dominant attributes but instead give you 1 LP (Level up Point). You can increase any attribute you wish by spending your LP. Attributes less than 16 need 1 LP to increase. Attributes equal or higher than 16 need 2 LP to increase. The arrows to increase attributes will become inactive once you have no LP or insufficient LP to upgrade an attribute. HP & AP will increase like before.

 New Moddable Game Mode properties 


 PlayerLevelAdjustment:x, Player will start the game at level x and with +25*x XP to spend in perks [Default if not set is 1 (Level 1)]
 PlayerWealthAdjustment:x, Player will start the game with x Farthings [Default if not set is 25 + 50xPlayerLevelAdjustment]
 StartingStage:x, Player will start their adventure in Stage x [Default if not set is 1 (Stage 1)]
 StartingStageLength:x, if you set the StartingStage x more than 1+, this property will override the initial length of that Stage to x.
 StartingNode:[Node], Set the 1st Node the player visits to the chosen node. [Default if not set is "Encounter"]
1st Node is the one after the Entry as the 'Entry' always need to exist
 Possible Nodes are: Encounter, Event, Elite, DungeonIntersection, CaveIntersection, BanditCampIntersection,Town, Camp, Merchant & Boss.


 New Game Mode: Expert 

Added a new Mode "Expert" as an example for modders on how to use these new settings in practice. Expert Mode starts the Player at Level 5 & at Stage 3. The first node you visit is a Town to invest your initial 225 Farthings.

 Other notable additions & balance changes 

 Hand Size can never exceed 7 (even with Perk Bonuses). Named Copies are still created even if you exceed a Hand size of 7, but not Invoked ones.
 Archetype Cache is now also purged when Restarting the Modmanager to allow overloading of archetypes without restarting the game itself.
 Intellect Bonus to starting hand reduced by -1. (Intellect 20 will now give Hand 6. Instead of Hand 7.)
 Improved Focus & Invoke algorithms
 Slightly improved Blood Mage's Actions to increase their survivability in earlier levels
 If Sneak Attack effect is synergized in a Card with only the AoE Damage effect, AoE will now benefit from the Sneak Attack bonus
 If Sneak Attack effect is synergized in a Card with both a Single Target Damage Effect & AoE Damage Effect, only the single Target Damage will benefit from the Sneak Attack bonus
 Vulnerability will pass to Intense Damage Effect & then to AoE Damage Effect if the Card doesn't have a Single Target Damage Effect, otherwise it will apply in the Single Target Damage Effect.
 Amplify bonus is now applied after the card damage is split to min & max damage range, and in most cases will result in a slightly higher damage output.
 Both the Split Element & the main Card Element are now Amplified. In example If Damage is Split, due to the Split or Imbue effects, the appropriate Amplify bonus will apply separately to each half of the damage. (Instead of the total.) So instead of rolling +3 Dark & +3 Bludgeoning damage you might for example end up rolling +4 Dark & +6 Bludgeoning Damage etc. In this case the combat log message will say that the enemy suffered 10 Dark+Bludgeoning Damage.
 If an AoE Damage effect exists along with a Single Target Damage Effect it will get separately Amplified & the Amplify Bonus will get reduced an additional time.
 Resistance will now trigger before Defend. Resistance will first try to absorb a portion of (or all) the damage, then Defend will try to absorb a portion of (or all) the damage, then any remaining damage is dealt normally.
 Card Copies created in your hand from Spellcraft or Invoke effects will appear in a dark red card frame to distinguish them from the cards in your deck



 Bugfixes 


 Perks that modify Effects, was incorrectly modyfing every effect's text instead of only that of the boosted effect. (This was a visual glitch & effects were otherwise calculated correctly.)
 Draw Hand was incorrectly using 7 as limit instead of Hand Size.
 Summoning & Discarding Equipment Cards was a cause of miscalculating the cards in Hand due to the asynchronous nature of creation & destruction.
 In certain mouse misbehaving cases an invisible object would spawn in the enemy area, it wasn't visible to the player but was preventing click methods to trigger in certain cases. 
 In certain mouse misbehaving cases or low frame rate cases action cards could stick in the battlefield. Momentarily dragging any other card or enemy will now make the formerly stuck card draggable once more.
 Any 'invisible' or stuck objects caused by mouse misbehaving or low frame rate will now get destroyed at end of turn,  once moving to a new node or any action card is played, to prevent unforseen errors and game stability issues.
 In certain cases enemy attack loop would skip the right-most enemy if their left-most companion met an untimely doom (i.e from retribution, bewitch, desecration etc.) The issue seems to be fixed for now, so let me know if it happens again.


Last but not least I uploaded an unofficial mod in Nexus for everyone who wants to lift the lore-based Gender Restrictions in Warlock, Spelldancer, Nymph & Ifrit classes & races, or to just see an example of a mod overloading core Classes & Races in action.

 EA Build 0197.1 

 Replicate copies will also appear in a dark red card frame to distinguish them from the cards in your deck
 Rearranging Enemies wasn't changing their attack order or their multicast order (after the 0197 update)
 Multicast [Self] wasn't triggering properly
 Synergy Meditate wasn't triggering properly
 Color coded the merchandise buttons in town (Actions & Consumables are Dark purple & Equipment dark brown)
 Actions you have 3 Copies will now appear without a Buy button in Towns
 Equipment you have 1 Copy & its equipped will now appear without a Buy button in Towns
 You can now sell owned and unequipped Equipment in Towns for half its price. Sell button will appear in medium red color to easily distinguish it.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0196 (Both Branches)
notes.notes:
EA Build 0196 (Both Branches)

Synergy can seem really complex, in your first few interactions with those cards. As there is no way for me to know which cards you'll synergize and do the math for you. But to get a better understanding how the synergy actually affects your cards, a compact card text will now show in the log under [cardname=>target] (and it will include all the modifications the card received).

In the screenshot below notice the difference between the "Look into my Eyes" in my hand and the one played after "And Now Sleep" in the log.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/973f36227c940fa8c5636f8e33d9fb3ec54b2b76.jpg


Wandering why your second Echo damaged you? Well you can now see in the log that it was because your first Echo, synergized it with Damage & you where its target. 

I have faith, that with a little practice you'll soon learn how to use too this powerful mechanic. And to predict exactly what will be the outcome of your combos. Of course if you have questions I am always here to help. ;)

Another concern about Synergy is that it's quite hard to memorize & learn all the keywords that can be synergized at once, and rightly so because there are over 80 keywords currently; and synergy was crafted in a way to support all present and future keywords. So whenever you wonder what a keyword does, you can look it up in the Terms Codex.

In the screenshot below I did 3 searches: "Phantasmal Blade", "Weaken" & "Synergy". The log will stay intact till you clear it or you move to a new node.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/f4a367e2870f761c114771d09f705957021cb4c3.jpg

Terms Codex

 Added an input field in the top part of the Combat log. There you can research various terms.
 Type your research term & hit enter or click the research button. All matches in the codex will show up.
 You can use the input field in the combat log to search for Card Effects, Races, Classes, Cards & Perks.
 For example you can search for Vampire while creating your character to get a look at the Vampire stats, proficiency & resistances. Or for 'Focus' if you are wondering what this keyword does once synergized into a Card. etc.
 You can also view the help sections that appear in Character Sheets & the Shortcuts button there by searching for Attributes,Deck,Equipment,Perks & Shortcuts.


 Bug fixes 

 Added 1 missing background image in Ice Caves & 2 in Infernal Caves that could cause in certain cases the game background to turn white
 Gluttony was incorrectly tagged as a hostile effect marking cards with it as 'Enemy'
 EnemyBane wasn't tagged at all. It's now classified as a hostile effect, marking cards with it as 'Enemy'.
 Improved the Drawing algorithm to take into account cards that perceived as present but are in reality marked for destruction

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0192 (Development Branch)
notes.notes:
EA Build 0192 - Development Branch 

It's recommended to update in this build if you are a modder or want to play as an Ifrit, Undine or Nephilim. You'll still have to unlock any new races you want to play with tokens, or with  a mod. ;)

 Misc Changes & Additions 

 Added 23 new Actions
 Added 17 New Perks
 Ifrit, Undine & Nephilim Races are fully playable (Have access to 12 Skills & 12 Perks and several non-Skill Actions handpicked from other Disciplines)
 Card Copies in the log, won't show anymore the +* postfix in their name. For simplicity they'll just display as the original Card name. i.e Angelic Shield +* => PC, will now simply display as Angelic Shield => PC.


 Modding Additions 

 Synergy 

Synergy is the most awesome Keyword to date, as it can be used for all available and future effects (aside Echo). Synergy injects new effects into the next Action you'll play this turn, and this effects trigger based on your next Actions level. The applications and possibilities of what you can do with this new Keyword is (allow me to say) mind blowing! :D 
 

 Synergy[Effect]:x 

 The next action you play this turn gains Effect:x. Effect can be any keyword except Echo, and will resolve according next action's evolution / empowerment.
 Value x displays with a *, because we are not in a position to know the next action & how it will evolve this value.
 Example1: SynergyDefend:3, next action gains Defend:3, but if next action is Level 2, this value will receive a +2 bonus giving you Defend +5.
 Example2: SynergyRetribution:-3, next action gains Retribution:-3, but if next action is Level 1, this value will receive a +1 bonus giving you Retribution:-2.
 The bonus effect is gained even if it didn't exist before in the action, if it does it modifies the existing effect by x.
 More than one instance of synergy can be present in an action: 
 Example3: SynergyFocus:1, SynergyMeditate:-2, next action gets both effects: draw 1* card and lose -2* AP.



 Archetypes can now be Gender-Restricted 

Perhaps is something you want in your mods or not. And it's up to you whether you use it. But it does make a lot of sense in a supernatural world: Succubi & Nymphs according their lore are females for example while Incubi & Satyrs are male only etc. 

So if you want to gender lock certain classes and races now you can.


 Use "RaceGenderRestriction": "Female" or "Male" To restrict a race archetype
 Use "ClassGenderRestriction": "Female" or "Male" To restrict a class archetype
 Don't add, remove this line, or set the gender to "" to allow using this archetype regardless of gender.
 Ifrits & Warlocks can be picked only by Male characters (You are free to remove this restriction from their .json archetype).
 Nymphs & Spelldancers (of Hecate) can be picked only by Female characters  (You are free to remove this restriction from their .json archetype).

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0190
notes.notes:
Build 0190 

This is a fairly large update (to download :P) as it both lays down the foundation for the upcoming sandbox/exploration mode and replaces all the old placeholder stage graphics. 

It also removes completely the 'Paths', as it was a source of confusion, and replaces them with fairly large Dungeons, Bandit Camps & Caves to explore.

I tried not to break your existing save games, so any Path nodes in your current game will act as a dungeon, bandit camp or cave node instead, and if you were in a  stage with only paths and no boss, a boss will now appear at the end of the stage. Still I would recommend to start a new run.

Misc changes & improvements


 Renamed 'Enemy Gallery' to 'Enemies Compendium'
 Renamed 'Card Collection' to 'Player's Handbook'
 Added a button in 'Player's Handbook' that will display the stats,disciplines,proficiency & resistances of the chosen Class (or Race) in the side panel.
 Replaced all the placeholder stage graphics with new stage graphics
 Events will no longer offer exploration opportunities. 
 Removed Paths & Replaced them with Dungeon, Bandit Camp & Cave nodes (depending the environment)
 Dungeons, Bandit Camps & Caves act like Caves were but now add a quite large amount of new nodes to explore.
 You can drag & reorder enemies. Which you can think of it as changing their relative position in the battlefield to your character. Reordering enemies changes:

 The order in which enemies act & decides which enemy will receive the retribution damage first.
 The targets of your multicast actions (that for example target the first 2 enemies)
 The target of your right click shortcut (targets the first enemy)

 Minor UI changes to accommodate the changes listed above.


If you encounter any issues or bugs with the new update let me know.

I'll dedicate the couple next builds to smooth things out and refine any rough edges. (For instance finding a Town in the middle of an infernal cavern is something that might happen, and won't be making much sense.) Once everything works out properly both in flavor and function, I will start working on the Sandbox mode.

Build 0190.1

 Combat log will clear only each time you advance a node. It will stay intact for the whole duration of the encounter unless the text limit is reached. (You can still clear it manually at any time.)
 Chain effect was destroying the original target instead of the chain target on lethal damage.
 Restricted the environments towns can appear


Build 0190.2

Restrictions as to where towns & exploration nodes could appear where too strict making their appearance way too rare & random.
 Towns will (once more) appear (in most game modes) at Stages 3,5,7 and have a 50% chance to appear in (most stages) after Stage 9.
 Exploration nodes will appear (in most game modes) at Stages: 3 to 7 and have a 75% chance to appear in (most stages) after Stage 9.
 Neither Towns nor Exploration nodes will appear inside other exploration nodes & stages that use interior graphics (like the infernal cave in Stage 8)
 Added additional checks and improved error handling in the Wildshape code
 Whenever a Lycanthrope uses the Wildshape effect to assume their Hybrid form, and as long the transformation is last, their Avatar Card will now change to reflect that. The character sheet avatar will remain unchanged.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0189
notes.notes:
Build 0189 

 New Action Effects 

 MulticastAll:1

 Action will Clone itself, then target & affect every enemy separately. (Replicate, Echo & Multicast effects aren't copied.)
 Exact wording is: Multicast (All). & detailed description: "This Action Targets & Affects (separately) all Enemies."

 Multicast:x

 Action will Clone itself, then target & affect the x first enemies separately. (Replicate, Echo & Multicast effects aren't copied.)
 Exact wording is: Multicast (x). & detailed description: "This Action Targets & Affects (separately) the first x Enemies."


 Notes for Modders: 


 Multicast Actions have effect only if the resolved target is an enemy. Players will receive any beneficial/harmful effects automatically each time the Multicast action clones. i.e [Multicast:3, Damage:3, Defend:3] can damage up to 3 targets for 3+ Damage & the player will receive up to +9 Defend (Adjust beneficial effects accordingly).
 Multicast Cloned Actions don't cost any additional AP to the player. (Adjust the initial cost accordingly.)
 Multicast Actions will gain an additional +1 XP each time they clone. i.e 3 XP for 2 Targets etc leveling up much faster, but the Multicast effect itself won't increase when a card levels up.



 New Actions 

Added around 54 new Actions & Equipment across all the Classes, Races & Loot database. Replaced several Card Artworks and adjusted several Cards effects (In particular all actions with retribution have now slightly different effects. If your mods override Actions from the Core Set, you may want to update their entries to match the updated Core Set ;)

 Retribution Nerf 


 Retribution value will drop each time you use it to deal damage to enemy. 
 If Retribution is higher than the amount necessary to kill an enemy, the remainder amount is used on the next enemy or debuffs normally if no other enemies exist.
 Adjusted Actions with Retribution to account for the effect nerf. Either Retribution is higher or the Action costs less AP.
 Effect text changed to: "Retribution x" & detailed description to: "Distribute up to x Intense Damage to each Enemy attacking you this Turn."
 Summon Retribution & Defend benefits remain unchanged till we evaluate the impact of this change in game difficulty.
	


 Bugfixes 


 Weaken Effect was applying an incorrect counter count & was resetting in some cases.
 Custom Card Artworks weren't showing on the side details panel.
 ModManager wasn't properly purging all deactivated Databases.
 Summons weren't leveling up instantly once they had accumulated the necessary XP.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0188
notes.notes:
Build 0188

 New Perks 

Added 36 new Perks, using the properties introduced in the previous build. Between the new perks and some of the older ones each Race & Class got plenty of new options:

 Additional Race Perks:  +2 Human, +6 Vampire, +6 Lycanthrope, +8 Demon
 Additional Class Perks: +6 Animist, +6 Necromancer, +6 Exorcist, +6 Witch, +6 Hunter, +6 Shadow, +6 Mystic, +6 Mercenary.


(Also added a reminder in the Character Sheet that Perks Lists are scrollable since I really dislike scrollbars.)

Perhaps the most interesting new addition, are the Perks granting new Disciplines. 

Each Class now has 2 Perks that allows them to gain access to another Class Card Set. For instance at Level 8 the Mercenary can spend 375xp and gain access to the Shadow's Cards or to Hunter's Cards, or eventually spend 750 xp and get access to both.

This won't make your Mercenary a Shadow, as you'll have to slowly grind or buy all the Shadow cards you like, neither will give you Mastery as Shadow. But will give much more choices and options and spice up your Endless run. You can even add your new Shadow Cards as Skills (by spending tokens).

 Modmanager Improvements 

You no longer need to restart the entire game after activating, deactivating, installing or uninstalling mods. The formerly 'Restart' button in ModManager is renamed to 'Restart ModManager' for better clarity on what it does. Restarting ModManager button, will take a few seconds for reasonable mod setups. It will purge all cached mod data from memory, and reload them. So always click this button after you install,uninstall,activate or deactivate any mods.

 Misc Changes & QoL Improvements 


 Added setting to adjust the speed of Enemy Attack Cards (1.2s,1.5s,2s,2.5s,3s & 3.5s) default value is 1.2s
 Changed the Enemy Attack Card 'animations' behaviour to delay slightly to start, giving more time to read the card

 Changed the description of Circle of Light & Darkness to Consecrate x & Desecrate x.

Effects now read: 

Consecrate x: Area emmits an Aura of Light for x Turns. Undead & Demons lose (ActionTier + EvolveCardBonus) HP. Everyone else restores (ActionTier + EvolveCardBonus) HP.

Desecrate x: Area emmits an Aura of Darkness for x Turns. Undead & Demons restore (ActionTier + EvolveCardBonus) HP. Everyone else loses (ActionTier + EvolveCardBonus) + HP.

Notice that the Negative Aura Effects cause loss of life (thus they cannot be resisted and are not subject to resistances or weaknesses)

Additionally Aura of Darkness & Light now cancel/dispel each other, regardless their tier. A relevant message will display in the log.

 If the Fatigue system is active in your Game Mode, after each Action a Concentration x/y reminder will now appear. Fatigue will kick in, after your Concentration drops to 0.

For example seeing in the core Ironman mode "Concentration 0/6", means that the 7th Action you'll use will cause +1 Fatigue. As a reminder Fatigue can be disabled completely or become more punishing by editing the corresponding Game Mode text files or by creating your own custom Game Modes. (See the Modding Guide)

 Hovering over an Echo indicator will now highlight its target (if its target exists. Echo actions with no target dispel at the beginning of EoT)


 Bugfixes 

 Fixed an issue with Enemy AI Response triggering even though the enemy was just destroyed a few seconds ago. Same issue could cause under certain cases exception errors.  (but let me know if an enemy proves too stubborn to accept death, and cause any additional issues)
 Fatigue Threshold was incorrectly increasing when Echo Actions were echoing.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0187
notes.notes:
Build 0187 

 Modding Additions & Enhancements

This build adds many new modding additions and enhancements, including fully customizable game modes, new perk keywords, new action keywords, SFX modding improvements and some quality of life improvements & bugfixes.

Disciplines

All Classes & Races can now 'inherit' Cards from any other Class or Race. The Cards an Archetype can find & use are now declared in the 'Disciplines' section for the archetype. In practice this means that Custom Class & Race Archetypes can now inherit Cards from other Classes & Races.

For example let's say you wanted to make a Succubus race, but want it to be able to use the core Demon Cards. Now you can by using in the Succubus Archetype: 

"Disciplines":[ 
"Succubus", 
"Demon" 
] 

 New Perk Properties to use in your Custom Perks


 AddDiscipline:[Discipline] & RemoveDiscipline:[Discipline], can give or remove disciplines from the Player. 

ie. AddDiscipline:Mystic, RemoveDiscipline:Mercenary will give the Player the Mystic Discipline but remove the Mercenary Discipline. The player will be able to find only Mystic cards in Merchants & Grimoires but not Mercenary cards, even if before they could.

Disciplines determine the cards you can find, so losing or adding disciplines don't change your class or your skills

  ModifyEffect[CardEffect]:x, can permanently alters how any numerical card effect is treated by the player. 

i.e ModifyEffectDefend:-1, means that from now on, in all cards with Defend value, the Defend value for the player is -1 point less.

i.e ModifyEffectConcealment:20, All cards that provide x% Concealement, from now on provide 20% more concealment etc.


 Card Collection fully supports custom races & classes 

Card Collection Filters are scrollable and are now populated dynamically by all defined races & class (Custom Class & Race Cardsets will now appear in the Card Gallery). Any Cards with the same type as class/race or of discipline belonging to class & race will appear in the collection

i.e If you have a custom class Blademaster, with Disciplines(Blademaster & Mercenary), both the Blademaster & Mercenary cards will get listed when view class cards

 Game Modes are fully Moddable 


 In addition to editing existing game modes, you can now use the Mods folder to create any number of new Game Modes you wish.

Put the [GameMode].json files in Mods/[Your Mod]/GameModes & declare them under 
>> GameModes in your ModLoaderUser.conf

 Your mod can also change Casual, Normal, Ironman & Endless modes, leaving the core files untouched. Your mod's modes have priority and override any core files they change.

 The Game Modes selector is scrollable & any loaded Modes will be displayed there giving you the choice to play any of them. You are also free to remove any core modes you don't use by editing the original ModLoader.conf.


 Mod Manager can now Activate or Deactivate Mods  

You can now deactivate mods without Uninstalling them. Just toggle on/off the Checkmark under the mod name. (It's always a good idea to restart the game after Activating, Deactivating, Removing & Adding Mods.)

 SFX Modding Additions & Improvements 


 Enemy Attack, Impact, Death SFX & AI Response sounds can be changed by modders.

While declaring the Enemies you can use AttackSFX:[Soundfile], ImpactSFX:[Soundfile] && DeathSFX:[Soundfile].

Sound filename doesn't have to be a number. 

i.e AttackSFX:ZombieMoan, ImpactSFX:BludgeoningImpact, DeathSFX:ZombieDeathCry 

 AttackSFX will play on attack start, ImpactSFX on attack impact & DeathSFX on enemy death. These Audio Files should also be located in ../Mods/[My Modname]/Audio/SFX

 Currently core Enemies play only the Impact SFX and by default is their Damage Type i.e Bludgeoning. You can override all default Impacts of a type ie. all Bludgeoning impacts by providing a Bludgeoning.wav file.

 You can override all special actions Effects i.e. the Gallop AI response, by providing a Gallop.wav file etc.

 Card Activation Effect can now be set with the new and more versatile ActivationSFX:[Soundfile] which doesn't have to be a number & it can also use internal resources.

i.e ActivationSFX:Poison will look for a file called Poison.wav (or mp3, or ogg) and play it each time the card activates.

 Clicking an enemy on the gallery will also play its AttackSFX file (which by default isn't set)

 Clicking a Card in Card Collection will display a larger artwork + the uncut version of the Card text & play its SFX impact sound, whether its internal or custom.


 New Action Effects 


 Festering x: If the Target is Bleeding, Festering Wound deals x Intense Damage to them.
 Resist[DamageType] x: Give the Caster resistance to a specific DamageType x, till the end of turn.

i.e. ResistSlashing:2, ResistPiercing:-2 will give +2 Slashing Resistance & -2 Piercing Resistance till the beginning of your next turn (This effect de-buffs after all enemies attack).


 Misc Changes & Improvements 


Rearranged Race & Class selectors to allocate space for more races & classes before it's necessary to scroll
 Removed the ink button from Enemy Gallery. Simply clicking on the card will display the Enemy info.
Whenever using an Action causes the Player or an Ally to gain or lose life due to its effects a relevant message displays in the log.
Towns will now always appear in Stage 3, 6 & 8 [Final Stages for Casual, Normal & Ironman] (instead of 3,5,7)
After Stage 8+ Towns have a 50% chance to appear in a Stage or not
Added a few new Actions in Vampire, Demon, Shadow, Exorcist & Animist


 Bugfixes 


 Card Evolution & XP were incorrectly saving only for Cards in Deck & for Cards in Hand.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0186
notes.notes:
Build 0186 

 QoL Improvements, New Features & Additions 

Clicking on Enemies (you have defeated) in the Enemy Gallery (or in the icon above their card) will now display their resistances, immunities & weaknesses. Displayed Stats are from the initial (lowest) level instance of that enemy. (Note though that, in higher levels Enemies can develop new or just higher resistances. So think of the Gallery as the equivalent of a PnP monster manual.)

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0185
notes.notes:
Build 0185

QoL Improvements, New Features & Additions

You can now not only increase, but also decrease any Attribute down to 6. Either to fine-tune them or to get more points to spend in other attributes.
 You can spend 5 tokens to add a non-Skill Action card to your Skills list. Once added to your Skills list the action will behave exactly like a skill for the duration of the run. Meaning you can freely add or remove it from your deck at any time. To convert a non-Skill action to a Skill, go to your Deck (D hotkey) and click on the 'S'-labeled button which will now appear in all non-Skill Actions in your Deck. 
 Deck Max size increased from 30 to 60 Cards (20 triplets, 60 singles or whatever).
 Skills, Equipment & Deck areas are now scrollable.
Deck count will now instantly refresh as you add & remove cards from the Skills or Deck UI.
Do note, that any Deck change or Perk addition is saved along with your Progress. For that matter, your game progress is now saved automatically after proceeding to the next node (instead of only entrances & campsites)
Added 9 new (medium to high level) Enemies (3x Ooze, 3x Serpentfolk, 3x Golems)
New AI Responses: Hybrid Form & Animal Ally.


 Card SFX are Moddable

Modders can change the sound effect that plays when using an Action Card
Audio files must be placed in Content/Mods/[Your Modname]/Audio/SFX
 WAV, MP3 & OGG files are all supported.
If a UserAudio flag is found in Card Declaration, the Modmanager will attempt to load the SFX file named as the card or as the numerical value of the flag. i.e Assuming you want custom SFX for 'Brutal Strike', add UserAudio:1 to the card declaration, then either a filename called Brutal Strike.wav or 1.wav in the SFX folder (in case you want to use the audio file more than once.)

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0184
notes.notes:
Build 0184 

Build 0184 brings an additional way to further customize your character and make them even stronger: Perks.

 Passive Perk System 

Added 10 Perks in each Race & 10 Perks in each Class (Common perks unlock at different levels depending the class & race strengths)
Perks can be bought with XP & give your Character passive bonuses for the duration of the run. XP spend on Perks are permanently lost delaying your Level Up, some time significantly. So it's up to you whether and when to use them.
Common Perks between your Race & Class can only be picked once. But in such cases the perk unlocks earlier in either your race or class, so you can pick it up from wherever it unlocks first.


It goes without saying, that if you used to find the game easy before, it will be way easier after investing your hard-earned XP in some perks. I will be mitigating that soon, with an AI abilities expansion. So perhaps in the meantime you can test it out in the endless mode ;)

 Modding the Perk System

Modders can both modify and add custom Perks in Core/Custom Races & Classes
Perks are defined in .tdb files placed in ../Content/Perks
Currently Perks can Increase/Reduce Attributes, HP, AP, Handsize, Proficiencies & Resistances, but more Perk effects will be introduced in the coming builds.
Any Perk .tdb declared under >> Perks in a ModLoader will be automatically parsed and added to the Perks Database.
Perks appear in the Perks section of Character Sheet based on the Archetype's PerkTree section.
I haven't forgot that I haven't updated the Modding Guide yet with the Game Modes and now with the Perk additions. Will do so in the coming days. ;)


 Misc Changes & Bugfixes 

 Added an extra 0.5s delay between each Enemy Attack to give more time in the attack SFX to complete before starting the next one.
 Having lost your unique companion could cause an exception error in save points (like camps or dungeon entries) leading to progress loss and various game errors.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0183
notes.notes:
Build 0183

 Hotkeys 

'Esc' key toggles (hides/shows) Main menu. When toggling it, the Main Menu state will stay intact (for example if you leave the Card Gallery open, opening the Main Menu will get you right back there).
'Space' key triggers [End Turn/Continue]. You can also Close (and Skip) Events & Loot Nodes by pressing the Space key [End Turn/Continue].
'C' key toggles (hides/shows) the Character Sheet in [Skills (Default)] view
'S' key opens/switches Character Sheet in [Skills] view
'P' key opens/switches Character Sheet in [Perks] view
'E' key opens/switches Character Sheet in [Equipment] view
'D' key opens/switches Character Sheet in [Deck] view
 'X' key will hide all Popups (Character Sheet, Events, Loot & Town). (If you close an Event or Loot window with this key, it's gone for good and you can't undo this action.)


 Misc Changes & Improvements 

You can now Pay 2 HP & discard any unwanted card from your hand by dropping it to the Backpack next to your Deck. (The Backpack will highlight when you are over the right spot).
When targeting an Enemy immune to a certain effect, or if the effect will fail 100% because the action/caster is much lower level than the enemy,
the message will now read: "[Effect] fails: [Target] is either Immune, or Action Level is too low to affect them". When the effect is resisted due to the 25% chance, the message will still read: "[Target] resists [Effect]".

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0181
notes.notes:
Build 0181

 All Game Mode properties (that matter) are now Moddable 

ModLoaders upgraded to load any GameMode.json files declared under >> GameModes & and placed in Content/GameModes/ (But currently only the Core Game Modes including Casual, Normal, Ironman & Endless can be played & modified)
 Game Mode Aspects that can be altered by editing the appropriate game mode files include:
 
Number of enemies that appear in Normal & Elite Encounters [MinEncounterNormalNum,MaxEncounterNormalNum,MinEncounterEliteNum,MaxEncounterEliteNum]
How higher can be the Elite Enemy Level in comparison to that of Normal Enemies [EliteLevelDifference]
The XP Gain Multiplier [XPGainMultiplier]
Bonus Starting Hit Points [InitialHPBonus]
Whether this game mode is Endless or Not [Endless]
If the game mode is not Endless after how many Stages the Gaunlet will be completed [StagesToCompleteTheRun]
How many Tokens & Mastery will be awarded if the Gaunlet is complete [RunCompletionRewardTokens, RunCompletionRewardMastery]
If Permadeath is forced or not [PermaDeath]
If Reincarnation takes a toll (value multiplied by stages cleared) [ReincarnationToll]
Whether Fatigue system is on or off [Fatigue]
If the Fatigue system is on how much is the threshold before it kicks in [FatigueThreshold]



Balance Changes

Now that everyone is free to set their own fatigue settings and change their game mode settings as they please, I decided to increase the fatigue threshold a bit, and adjust the stage lengths to what I think should be the vanilla difficulties.


Casual Mode ends after 3 Stages & awards on Completion +5 (Bonus) Tokens & Mastery. Fatigue will incur at 10+ Actions.
Normal Mode ends after 6 Stages & awards on Completion +10 (Bonus) Tokens & Mastery. Fatigue will incur at 8+ Actions.
Ironman Mode ends after 8 Stages & awards on Completion +15 (Bonus) Tokens & Mastery. Fatigue will incur at 6+ Actions.


There is also an endless mode, but currently is very experimental and a work in progress. For now I just needed it to establish the modding framework regarding Game Modes. If anyone wants to try it out, let me know of your thoughts on the difficulty and boss scaling after stage 8, everything before that should be similar to Ironman except the XP Gain, Starting HP bonus & Fatigue threshold.

 Bugfixes 

Ending Turn without using any Cards would draw bonus cards in some cases
Wildshape code could lead into an exception error in some rare cases

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0180
notes.notes:
Build 0180

There are 2 big changes you will notice in this build. 

One, is that the enemies will no longer move towards your direction to attack you, but instead conjure a card and literally throw it at you. Additionally, each time an Enemy is about to use a special ability, a card will also appear briefly to notify you. The floating damage no longer appears in the PC portrait, as I found it distracting to properly observe the attack & status enemy cards.

The second important change is the Fatigue system.

 Fatigue 

Each time you use a card after a certain threshold (defined by the game difficulty) you gain +1 Fatigue. Then for each fatigue counter the AP cost of your Actions increase by +1.


Casual: You can use 8 Actions before incurring fatigue penalty.
Normal: You can use 6 Actions before incurring fatigue penalty.
Ironman: You can use 4 Actions before incurring fatigue penalty.


Let's say for example that you play in Normal. You can use 6 Actions without incurring a Fatigue penalty. The 7th will increase your Fatigue by +1, so the 8th Action will cost +1 AP and will further increase your Fatigue by another +1, so the 9th Action will cost +2 AP etc. At the End of Turn any fatigue penalty you have incurred is lost.

I doubt that this change will affect you much in Casual & Normal, but hopefully will give you an increased challenge in Ironman. You don't have to remember any of this, as cards AP cost will update accordingly. This is a big change and the values used before you incur the penalty are experimental. Let me know of your thoughts in the forum.

There is also a new Action Effect "Fatigue:x" for modders to use while crafting Actions. This effect increases or reduces the Caster's Fatigue by x.

 Other Balance Changes 

Various Actions adjusted based on the Community feedback
Slightly Increased the Boss level (for the purpose of resisting negative effects)
Each time per turn you use Amplify to boost an Action's damage without the Amplify effect, will now reduce your Amplify bonus by 25%, (down to 2.) This is tracked separately for each element, i.e. Amplify bonus in "Slashing Damage" will be reduced when you deal Slashing Damage.


Bugfixes

Card descriptions wouldn't refresh immediately after transitioning to a new area and Empower had just de-buffed.
Card Count in deck wouldn't refresh right away as Grimoire or Purchased cards were added in it.
Area Graphics should now cycle properly in higher Nodes
Enemies could move and hide behind each other while performing their attack animation. This should no longer be an issue, as enemies are no longer moving. (But let me know if it's still happening when they die though.)

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0179
notes.notes:
Build 0179 

As of this build, the only reported issue that remains in my list to fix is a more sophisticated save state for the Consumable items (with more than 1 uses). This isn't really a high priority item though and is planned to arrive shortly after Sandbox mode is finished. The issue is that all consumables of same type are tracked collectively, and their counter resets once one is destroyed from your deck. End result, is that you do use them as many times as you are supposed to, but a) the counters are confusing and b) also reset once you reload the game. Therefore is necessary to have a separate save-state reflecting the exact status of all consumables in deck, but it can certainly wait. 

Unless I forgot something important, or something urgent arises that needs fixing in the coming days, I'll skip publishing a couple of builds in order to start working on some new features, that will take significant planning and code base changes.

First in order will be the passive perks and afterwards a sandbox exploration mode that will pave the road for the story mode.

So if you have any ideas on passive perks feel free to drop by the forum, and let me know. 

The way passive perks will work, is that you'll be able to exchange earned XP to unlock passive bonuses for your character. These will be racial and class based ie. Vampires & Lycanthropes might have a perk giving them Slashing Resistance, or increased Speed (AP cost reduction). Mercenaries may have perks improving their training with various weaponry etc. Of course spending XP on perks will delay Leveling up, so it's a choice you have to consciously make.

On a different note, in this build I heavily adjusted all the Actions in the game, to reflect the collective feedback regarding balance so far. And while I doubt this will make the game more difficult for those struggling in late stages, it might make it much easier for everyone. So looking forward to hear your thoughts on that.

 QoL Improvements

I went through all the Actions and adjusted/lowered where necessary their AP costs or increased their damage, based on the overall community feedback regarding balance so far.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0171
notes.notes:
Build 0171

Initial Difficulty Controls & Permadeath Rules

You can now choose between 3 Difficulty Settings:

Casual
If your character dies you can choose to retain your savefile and return back to main menu, or reincarnate and receive your bonus Tokens & Mastery.

Special Rules: Your character starts with +5 Hit Point but gains 20% XP less than Normal.

Normal 
If your character dies you can choose to retain your savefile and return back to main menu, or reincarnate and receive your bonus Tokens & Mastery.
 If you choose to retain your savefile you'll lose 1 Token per stage cleared (-0 at 1st Stage, -1 at 2nd, -2 at 3rd etc)

Ironman
Death is final. The moment you die your savefile is gone, and you can only reincarnate and receive your bonus Tokens & Mastery. 

Special Rules: Your character gains 20% XP more than Normal.

Developer's notes: These are some initial settings to establish the basic code framework handling difficulties. By no means are final, but they should provide a slightly different experience while keeping things somewhat fair. Eventually these difficulties will be changing much more aspects of the actual gameplay difficulty, but i still need your feedback and thoughts regarding balance before starting to messing things up more. Existing saves (for compatibility purposes) will be treated as if you chose the "Casual" Difficulty.
